<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-c361a9"/>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/12/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/12/1" id="section-12-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 80 of the Environment Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1995/25" id="c00005" Year="1995" Number="25" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct">1995 (c. 25)</Citation> (national air quality strategy), after subsection (7) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers may by regulations amend this section for the purpose of changing the period within which they must review the strategy.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/12/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/12/2" id="section-12-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 87 of that Act (regulations for the purposes of Part 4), after subsection (9) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>9A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A statutory instrument containing regulations under section 80(8) may not be made unless a draft of the instrument has been laid before, and approved by resolution of, Senedd Cymru.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Pblock></Chapter></Part></Body></Primary></Legislation>

<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-bf9fee"/>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/1" id="section-14-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After section 81A of the Environment Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1995/25" id="c00007" Year="1995" Number="25" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct">1995 (c.25)</Citation> insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>
<Title>Functions of relevant Welsh public authorities etc.</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">81B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following persons must have regard to the policies published by the Welsh Ministers in the strategy when exercising any function of a public nature that could affect the quality of air in Wales—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>local authorities in Wales;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>relevant Welsh public authorities.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Part, “<Term>relevant Welsh public authority</Term>” means a person designated in accordance with subsection (3) as a relevant Welsh public authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers may by regulations designate a person as a relevant Welsh public authority if (and only if) that person is a “devolved Welsh authority” within the meaning of section 157A(1)(a) of the Government of Wales Act 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before making regulations under subsection (3), the Welsh Ministers must consult—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the person that is proposed to be designated, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>such other persons as the Welsh Ministers consider appropriate.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/2" id="section-14-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 87 of that Act (regulations for the purposes of Part 4), in subsection (2)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/2/a" id="section-14-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (c), after “relevant public authorities” insert <InlineAmendment>“, relevant Welsh public authorities”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/2/b" id="section-14-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (j), after “relevant public authorities,” insert <InlineAmendment>“relevant Welsh public authorities,”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/2/c" id="section-14-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (l), after “relevant public authorities” insert <InlineAmendment>“, relevant Welsh public authorities”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/2/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/2/d" id="section-14-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (m), after “a relevant public authority” insert <InlineAmendment>“, a relevant Welsh public authority”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/3" id="section-14-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 88 of that Act (guidance for the purposes of Part 4)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/3/a" id="section-14-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (3)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/3/a/i" id="section-14-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for “This section” substitute <InlineAmendment>“Subsections (1) and (2)”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/3/a/ii" id="section-14-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for “it applies” substitute <InlineAmendment>“they apply”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/3/b" id="section-14-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after subsection (3) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers may issue guidance to relevant Welsh public authorities with respect to, or in connection with, the exercise of any of the powers conferred, or the discharge of any of the duties imposed, on those authorities by section 81B or regulations made by the Welsh Ministers under this Part.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A relevant Welsh public authority, in exercising those powers and discharging those duties, must have regard to any guidance issued under subsection (4).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/14/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/14/4" id="section-14-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 91 of that Act (interpretation of Part 4), in subsection (1), after the entry for “relevant public authority” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>relevant Welsh public authority</Term>” has the meaning given by section 81B(2);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Pblock></Chapter></Part></Body></Primary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2" NumberOfProvisions="77" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="2.0" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/body" NumberOfProvisions="41" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1" NumberOfProvisions="34" id="part-1" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Number>PART 1</Number><Title>AIR QUALITY</Title><Chapter DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2" NumberOfProvisions="25" id="part-1-chapter-2" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2025-07-31"><Number>CHAPTER 2</Number><Title>OTHER PROVISION</Title><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2/crossheading/local-air-quality-management" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2/crossheading/local-air-quality-management" NumberOfProvisions="4" id="part-1-chapter-2-crossheading-local-air-quality-management" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2025-07-31"><Title>Local air quality management</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2025-07-31"><Title>Local authority air quality reviews</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/16" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/16" id="section-16">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-198859"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-02017e"/>16</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/16/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/16/1" id="section-16-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 82 of the Environment Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1995/25" id="c00009" Year="1995" Number="25" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct">1995 (c. 25)</Citation> (local authority reviews) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/16/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/16/2" id="section-16-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1), after “local authority” insert <InlineAmendment>“, other than a local authority in Wales,”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/16/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/16/3" id="section-16-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (1) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Every local authority in Wales must, in each calendar year, cause a review to be conducted of the quality for the time being, and the likely future quality within the relevant period, of air within the authority’s area.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/16/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/16/4" id="section-16-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), after “subsection (1)” insert <InlineAmendment>“or (1A)”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Pblock></Chapter></Part></Body></Primary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2" NumberOfProvisions="77" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="2.0" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/body" NumberOfProvisions="41" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1" NumberOfProvisions="34" id="part-1" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Number>PART 1</Number><Title>AIR QUALITY</Title><Chapter DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2" NumberOfProvisions="25" id="part-1-chapter-2" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2025-07-31"><Number>CHAPTER 2</Number><Title>OTHER PROVISION</Title><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2/crossheading/local-air-quality-management" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2/crossheading/local-air-quality-management" NumberOfProvisions="4" id="part-1-chapter-2-crossheading-local-air-quality-management" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2025-07-31"><Title>Local air quality management</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2025-07-31"><Title>Action plans in relation to air quality management areas</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/17" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/17" id="section-17">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-529ee0"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-8208ca"/>17</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/17/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/17/1" id="section-17-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After section 83A of the Environment Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1995/25" id="c00010" Year="1995" Number="25" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct">1995 (c. 25)</Citation> insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>
<Title>Duties of Welsh local authorities in relation to designated areas</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">83B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This section applies in relation to a local authority in Wales.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A local authority must, for the purpose of securing that air quality standards and objectives are achieved in an air quality management area designated by the authority—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>prepare an action plan in relation to that area, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>send a copy of the action plan to the Welsh Ministers for approval.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An action plan is a written plan that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sets out how the local authority will exercise its functions to secure that air quality standards and objectives are achieved in the area to which the plan relates, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to each standard and objective, specifies a date by which the local authority will aim to achieve the standard or objective.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An action plan must also set out how the local authority will exercise its functions to secure that air quality standards and objectives are maintained after they have been achieved in the area to which the plan relates.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An action plan must—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>set out particular measures the local authority will take to secure the achievement and maintenance of air quality standards and objectives in the area to which the plan relates, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to each measure, specify a date by which it will be carried out.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A local authority—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>may prepare revisions to an action plan at any time, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>must prepare revisions to an action plan if it considers that there is a need for further or different measures to be taken to secure that air quality standards and objectives are achieved by the dates specified under subsection (3)(b), and are maintained, in the area to which the plan relates.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A local authority must send copies of revisions prepared under subsection (6) to the Welsh Ministers for approval.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An action plan, or a revision to an action plan, does not take effect unless the plan or revision is approved (with or without modifications) by the Welsh Ministers.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/17/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/17/2" id="section-17-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 84 of that Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/17/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/17/2/a" id="section-17-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (1A), omit “or Wales”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/17/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/17/2/b" id="section-17-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the heading, omit “and Welsh”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/17/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/17/3" id="section-17-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 91 of that Act, in the definition of “action plan” in subsection (1), after paragraph (a) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem NumberOverride="aa">
<Para>
<Text>in relation to Wales, in accordance with section 83B;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Pblock></Chapter></Part></Body></Primary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2" NumberOfProvisions="77" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="2.0" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/body" NumberOfProvisions="41" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1" NumberOfProvisions="34" id="part-1" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Number>PART 1</Number><Title>AIR QUALITY</Title><Chapter DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2" NumberOfProvisions="25" id="part-1-chapter-2" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2025-07-31"><Number>CHAPTER 2</Number><Title>OTHER PROVISION</Title><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2/crossheading/vehicle-emissions" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2/crossheading/vehicle-emissions" NumberOfProvisions="3" id="part-1-chapter-2-crossheading-vehicle-emissions" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2024-04-14"><Title>Vehicle emissions</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2024-04-14"><Title>Stationary idling offence: fixed penalty</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24" id="section-24">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-a10afd"/>24</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/1" id="section-24-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Environment Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1995/25" id="c00015" Year="1995" Number="25" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct">1995 (c.25)</Citation> is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/2" id="section-24-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 87 (regulations for the purposes of air quality)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/a" id="section-24-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (2), in paragraph (o)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/a/i" id="section-24-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the words from “by payment of” to the end become sub-paragraph (i);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/a/ii" id="section-24-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (i) insert </Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" PartialRefs="p10001" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<Text>, or</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by payment of a penalty of an amount that falls within a prescribed range, where the prescribed offence is a stationary idling offence prescribed by the Welsh Ministers and such a range is prescribed;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/b" id="section-24-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after subsection (2A) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2)(o)(ii), “stationary idling offence means an offence under section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 that consists of a contravention of, or failure to comply with, so much of regulation 98 of the Road Vehicle (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 (stopping of engine when stationary) as relates to the prevention of exhaust emissions.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/3" id="section-24-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 11 (air quality: supplemental provision), in paragraph 5 (fixed penalty offences), in sub-paragraph (6)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/3/a" id="section-24-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “fixed penalty”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/3/a/i" id="section-24-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the words from “a penalty of such amount” to the end become paragraph (a);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/3/a/ii" id="section-24-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of paragraph (a) insert </Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="schedule" PartialRefs="p10002" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<Text>, or</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a penalty of such amount falling within a range prescribed in regulations as is specified in a fixed penalty notice;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/3/b" id="section-24-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “fixed penalty notice”, at the end insert <InlineAmendment>“or an amount falling within a range prescribed in regulations”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Pblock></Chapter></Part></Body></Primary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2" NumberOfProvisions="77" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="2.0" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/body" NumberOfProvisions="41" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1" NumberOfProvisions="34" id="part-1" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-01-23"><Number>PART 1</Number><Title>AIR QUALITY</Title><Chapter DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2" NumberOfProvisions="25" id="part-1-chapter-2" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2025-07-31"><Number>CHAPTER 2</Number><Title>OTHER PROVISION</Title><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2/crossheading/vehicle-emissions" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/part/1/chapter/2/crossheading/vehicle-emissions" NumberOfProvisions="3" id="part-1-chapter-2-crossheading-vehicle-emissions" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2024-04-14"><Title>Vehicle emissions</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2024-04-14"><Title>Stationary idling offence: fixed penalty</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24" id="section-24">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-a10afd"/>24</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/1" id="section-24-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Environment Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1995/25" id="c00015" Year="1995" Number="25" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct">1995 (c.25)</Citation> is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/2" id="section-24-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 87 (regulations for the purposes of air quality)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2/section/24/2/a" id="section-24-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-e6edba"/>35</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/35/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/35/1" id="section-35-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After section 6A of the Environment Act (as inserted by section 39 of this Act), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<Pblock>
<Title>Biodiversity targets</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Biodiversity targets: general</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">6B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers may by regulations set targets in respect of any matter relating to biodiversity in Wales.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers may set a target in the regulations only if they are satisfied that meeting it would contribute to halting and reversing the decline in biodiversity or to restoring biodiversity to resilient levels, in particular through one or more of the following—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>increasing the abundance of native species;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>enhancing the resilience of ecosystems (in particular the aspects specified in section 6(2)(a) to (e));</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>increasing genetic diversity.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In considering whether a target would contribute to‍ the matters specified in subsection (2)(a), (b) or (c), the Welsh Ministers must have regard to the list published under section 7.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The regulations must, in relation to each target—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>specify a standard to be achieved, which must be capable of being objectively measured, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>specify a date by which the standard is to be achieved.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The regulations must—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>include provision about how to measure—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>progress towards achieving each standard specified under subsection (4), and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>whether the standard has been achieved, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>specify indicators as a means of measuring those things.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A target under this section is set when the regulations setting it come into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this section—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>native species</Term>” means species that naturally occur or have in the past naturally occurred in Wales, including—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="roman" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>regularly occurring migratory species (both breeding and non-breeding) and natural colonists, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>species that have been reintroduced in Wales following past extinction;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>natural colonists</Term>” means species that arrived in Wales of their own accord and have become established, including those that become migratory species.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In sections 6C, 6D, 6G, 6H and 6I, “specified standard” and “<Term>specified date</Term>”, in relation to a target set under this section, mean the standard and date specified under subsection (4).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Duty to make regulations setting targets: priority areas</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">6C</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers must exercise the power in section 6B to‍ —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>set a long-term target in respect of at least one matter within each of the priority areas in subsection (2)(a) and (b),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>set a short-term target in respect of at least one matter within each of the priority areas in subsection (2)(a) and (b), and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>set a target in respect of at least one matter within each of the priority areas in subsection (2)(c) and (d).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The priority areas are—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>reducing the risk of the extinction of native species;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the effective management of ecosystems;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>reducing pollution;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the quality of evidence to inform decisions relating to biodiversity, access to that evidence and its use and application.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A target is a “long-term target” if the specified date is at least 15 years after the date on which the target is set.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A target is a “short-term target” if the specified date is less than 15 years after the date on which the target is set.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Targets may not be set in respect of a matter within the priority area in subsection (2)(c) if a target may be set in respect of that matter under the Environment (Air Quality and Soundscapes) (Wales) Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2024/2" id="c00014" Year="2024" Number="2" Class="WelshParliamentAct">2024 (asc 2)</Citation>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2)(a), ”native species” has the meaning given by section 6B(7).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers must lay a draft of a Welsh statutory instrument containing the regulations required by this section before Senedd Cymru before the end of the period of‍ 2 years beginning with the date on which the Environment (Principles, Governance and Biodiversity Targets) (Wales) Act 2026 (asc xx) receives Royal Assent.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Target-setting process</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">6D</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before making regulations under section 6B, the Welsh Ministers must seek advice from persons they consider to be independent and to have relevant expertise.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers must publish a summary of any such advice they receive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>When making regulations under section 6B, the Welsh Ministers must apply the principles of sustainable management of natural resources.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before making regulations under section 6B, the Welsh Ministers must publish a report summarising—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the consultation that was carried out in connection with the regulations, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any representations that were received as a result of the consultation.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before making regulations under section 6B that set or amend a target, the Welsh Ministers must be satisfied that the target or amended target can be met.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Part, a target is met if the specified standard is achieved by the specified date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subsections (1) to‍ (4) do not apply to provisions in regulations under section 6B that revoke a target that has been met.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Duty to meet targets</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">6E</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers must ensure that targets set in regulations made under section 6B are met.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Designation of public authorities for the purpose of section 6(2A)</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">6F</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers may by regulations designate a public authority within section 6(11) in relation to a target set in regulations made under section 6B.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before making regulations under this section, the Welsh Ministers must consult—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the public authority they propose to designate, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>such other persons as they consider appropriate.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Review of targets</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">6G</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers may, from time to time, review a target set in regulations under section 6B.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers must review a target set in regulations under section 6B if it appears to them—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>that the target may not be met, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>that the target may no longer be appropriate.‍</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers may, from time to time, review the effectiveness of all current targets for the purpose of determining whether setting further targets in regulations under section 6B would be more effective in contributing to halting and reversing the decline in biodiversity or to restoring biodiversity to resilient levels.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers must review the effectiveness of all current targets for the purpose mentioned in subsection (3)—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if a target set in regulations under section 6B has not been met by the specified date in relation to that target;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if 10 years have passed since the most recently completed review under any of subsection (3), this subsection or subsection (5).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If no review under subsection (3) or (4) has been completed before the end of 2041, the Welsh Ministers must review the effectiveness of all current targets for the purpose mentioned in subsection (3).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A target is current for the purpose of subsections (3) to (5) if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it has been set in regulations under section 6B that are in force at the time of the review, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it has not been met at that time.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In carrying out a review under this section, the Welsh Ministers must seek advice from persons they consider to be independent and to have relevant expertise.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers must publish a summary of any such advice they receive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After carrying out a review under this section, the Welsh Ministers must lay before Senedd Cymru, and publish, a statement noting its conclusions.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If‍ a review under subsection (1) or (2) concludes that a target will not be met or is no longer appropriate, the statement must note the reasons for that conclusion and the steps, if any, the Welsh Ministers intend to take in relation to the target in consequence of the review.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If a review under subsection (3), (4) or (5) concludes that further targets should be set in regulations under section 6B, the Welsh Ministers must lay a draft of a Welsh statutory instrument containing such regulations before Senedd Cymru before the end of the period of 2 years beginning with the day on which the review was completed.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A review is completed for the purpose of subsections (4)(b), (5) and (11) when the statement required by subsection (9) is published.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Revoking or lowering targets</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">6H</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers may not make regulations under section 6B that revoke or lower a target (the “existing target”) unless they are satisfied that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>because of changes to the evidence to which they had regard when setting the existing target, meeting it would not contribute to halting and reversing the decline in biodiversity or to restoring biodiversity to resilient levels,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>meeting the existing target would have no significant benefit compared with not meeting it or with meeting a lower target,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>because of changes in circumstances since the existing target was set, the environmental, social, economic or other costs of meeting it would be disproportionate to the benefits, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>meeting the existing target is no longer achievable—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>because of changes in circumstances since the existing target was set, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>because of changes to the evidence to which the Welsh Ministers had regard when setting the existing target.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If the Welsh Ministers are satisfied that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the costs of meeting the existing target would be disproportionate to the benefits as mentioned in subsection (1)(c), or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>meeting the existing target is no longer achievable as mentioned in subsection (1)(d),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>they must, before making regulations under section 6B that revoke the target, consider whether to make regulations that lower the target.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before making regulations under section 6B that revoke or lower a target, the Welsh Ministers must lay before Senedd Cymru, and publish, a statement explaining why the Welsh Ministers are satisfied as mentioned in subsection (1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulations lower a target if, to any extent, they—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>replace the specified standard with a lower standard, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>replace the specified date with a later date.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This section does not apply to provisions in regulations under section 6B that revoke a target that has been met.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Statement about targets</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">6I</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>On or before the specified date in relation to each target set under regulations under section 6B, the Welsh Ministers must lay before Senedd Cymru, and publish, a statement containing the required information.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The required information is (as appropriate)—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>that the target has been met,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>that the target has not been met, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>that the Welsh Ministers are not yet able to determine whether the target has been met, the reasons for that and the steps the Welsh Ministers intend to take in order to determine whether the target has been met.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the Welsh Ministers make a statement that a target has not been met, the Welsh Ministers must, before the end of‍ 6 months beginning with the date on which the statement is laid, lay before Senedd Cymru, and publish, a report.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The report must—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>explain why the target has not been met, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>set out the steps the Welsh Ministers have taken, or intend to take, to ensure the target is met as soon as reasonably practicable.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before deciding on the steps referred to in subsection (4)(b), the Welsh Ministers must seek advice from persons they consider to be independent and to have relevant expertise.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers must publish a summary of any such advice they receive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the Welsh Ministers make a statement that they are not yet able to determine whether a target has been met, the Welsh Ministers must, before the end of 6 months beginning with the date on which the statement is laid, lay before Senedd Cymru, and publish, a further statement containing the required information.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subsections (2) to (7) apply to further statements under subsection (7) as they apply to a statement under subsection (1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Pblock>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/35/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/35/2" id="section-35-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before section 7 of the Environment Act, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<FragmentTitle Context="Pblock">
<Title>Biodiversity lists</Title>
</FragmentTitle>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/35/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/35/3" id="section-35-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 25(4) of the Environment Act, after “section 22(1)” insert <InlineAmendment>“, or to revoke a target that has been set in regulations under section 6B and that has been met,”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Primary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4" NumberOfProvisions="92" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="2.0" TerritorialApplication="W" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-10-05"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/body" NumberOfProvisions="58" NumberFormat="default" TerritorialApplication="W" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-10-05"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/part/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/part/3" NumberOfProvisions="16" id="part-3" TerritorialApplication="W" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-06-27"><Number>PART 3</Number><Title>BIODIVERSITY TARGETS, ETC.</Title><P1group TerritorialApplication="W" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-06-27"><Title>Public authorities’ duties</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/36" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/36" id="section-36">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-70ac22"/>36</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/36/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/36/1" id="section-36-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After section 6(2) of the Environment Act, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In complying with subsection (1), a public authority within subsection (11) that has been designated in regulations under section 6F must take action to contribute to meeting the target in relation to which it has been designated.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/36/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/36/2" id="section-36-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 6(5)(d) of the Environment Act, at the beginning, insert <InlineAmendment>“where the public authority is one within subsection (11),”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/36/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/36/3" id="section-36-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 6(9) of the Environment Act, in the definition of “public authority”, at the end of paragraph (e) insert <InlineAmendment>“, but not the Office of Environmental Governance Wales”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/36/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/36/4" id="section-36-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>

<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b440c8"/>38</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/38/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/38/1" id="section-38-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 6(7) of the Environment Act, for “to comply with subsection (1)” substitute</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" PartialRefs="p10001" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<Text id="p10001"> —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to comply with subsection (1), and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where subsection (2A) applies, to contribute to meeting the target in relation to which it has been designated</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/38/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/38/2" id="section-38-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After section 6(7) of the Environment Act, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The report published by the Welsh Ministers under subsection (7) must, in particular, report on the progress being made towards meeting the targets set in regulations under section 6B and whether they are likely to be met.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>As soon as reasonably practicable after publishing their report under subsection (7), the Welsh Ministers must send a copy of it to the Office of Environmental Governance Wales.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7C</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Sending a copy of the report under subsection (7B) is to be treated as a request by the Welsh Ministers to the Office of Environmental Governance Wales for advice under section 13 of the Environment (Principles, Governance and Biodiversity Targets) (Wales) Act 2026 (asc xx).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Primary></Legislation>

<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-e23d0b"/>40</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/40/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/40/1" id="section-40-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the italic cross-heading preceding section 9 of the Environment Act, substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<FragmentTitle Context="Pblock">
<Title>Duties of the Welsh Ministers</Title>
</FragmentTitle>
</BlockAmendment>

</P2para>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/4/section/40/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/4/section/40/2" id="section-40-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After that italic cross-heading, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>
<Title>Duty to promote awareness of biodiversity</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">8A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers must take steps to promote awareness in Wales of the importance of biodiversity and of the threats to biodiversity.</Text>

</P2para>

</P1para>

Part 6 Waste managementIntegrated waste management plans341After section 44 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 (c. 43) there is inserted—<Emphasis>Integrated waste management plans: Scotland</Emphasis>Duty to prepare integrated waste management plan44ZA1It shall be the duty of a local authority to—aprepare an integrated waste management plan; andbsubmit it to the Scottish Ministers for approval.2An integrated waste management plan is a plan which—asets out, by reference to policies contained in the National Waste Strategy, how the local authority intends to carry out its functions as waste disposal authority and waste collection authority (its “waste management functions”); andbwithout prejudice to the generality of paragraph (a) above, contains statements on such matters relating to the carrying out of those functions as the Scottish Ministers may specify in directions.3Directions under subsection (2)(b) above may, in particular, require integrated waste management plans to include statements setting out—alevels of performance (“performance targets”) which the local authority shall, in performing its waste management functions, endeavour to meet;bsteps which the local authority proposes to take in endeavouring to meet performance targets;carrangements which the local authority proposes to enter into with one or more other local authorities for the purpose of securing co-operation, in the carrying out of their respective waste management functions, between the local authorities.4Integrated waste management plans shall—abe prepared, and submitted, under subsection (1) above by such date; andbrelate to such period of time,as the Scottish Ministers may direct.5A local authority shall, in preparing its integrated waste management plan, have regard to such matters as the Scottish Ministers may direct.6In this section, and in sections 44ZB to 44ZD below—“local authority” means a council constituted under section 2 of the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994 (c. 39);“National Waste Strategy” means the strategy prepared by SEPA under section 44B below, as modified from time to time; and“SEPA” means the Scottish Environment Protection Agency.Approval of integrated waste management plan44ZB1The Scottish Ministers shall—aapprove an integrated waste management plan submitted to them under section 44ZA(1)(b) above without modification;bapprove the plan with such modifications as they consider appropriate; orcrefuse to approve the plan.2If the Scottish Ministers refuse to approve a plan which has been so submitted they shall—anotify the local authority in writing of that fact; andbrequire the local authority to prepare and submit, by such date as the Scottish Ministers may specify, a further integrated waste management plan.3The Scottish Ministers shall—aapprove an integrated waste management plan submitted to them under subsection (2)(b) above without modification; orbapprove the plan with such modifications as they consider appropriate.4The Scottish Ministers shall—agive written notice of their approval, under subsection (1) or (3) above, of an integrated waste management plan to the local authority; andbif they have modified the plan, send a copy of the plan as modified to the local authority.5The local authority shall, on receipt of notice given under subsection (4)(a) above—agive public notice of the approved integrated waste management plan; andbsend a copy of it to SEPA.6It shall be the duty of a local authority to make arrangements for allowing any person to—ainspect its approved integrated waste management plan at its principal offices at any reasonable time;bobtain a copy of it, or any part of it, on payment of such reasonable fee (if any) as the local authority may determine.Implementation of integrated waste management plan44ZC1It shall be the duty of a local authority—ato endeavour to carry out its waste management functions in accordance with its approved integrated waste management plan; andbif requested by the Scottish Ministers, to provide the Scottish Ministers, by the date specified in their request, with a statement setting out whether the local authority is so carrying out its waste management functions.2A statement provided under subsection (1)(b) above shall contain such information as the Scottish Ministers may direct.3Directions under subsection (2) above may, in particular, require a local authority to—aadvise whether it has met, or is likely to meet, any performance targets set out in the plan; andbif it has not done so, or is not likely to do so, explain why it considers the performance targets have not been, or are not likely to be, met.Modification of integrated waste management plan44ZD1A local authority—amay, from time to time; andbshall, if requested by the Scottish Ministers,modify its integrated waste management plan and submit it, as modified, to the Scottish Ministers for approval.2Sections 44ZA to 44ZC apply in relation to a plan which is modified as they apply in relation to a plan prepared and submitted under section 44ZA(1) above..2Section 49(waste recycling plans) of that Act of 1990 is repealed.

andiiaddress at which,payment may be made;dthe method or methods by which payment may be made;ethe consequences of not making a payment within the period for payment.4The amount of the fixed penalty under section 80(4A) is—ain the case of a nuisance relating to industrial, trade or business premises, £400;bin any other case, £150.5The period for payment of the fixed penalty is 14 days beginning with the day after the day on which the notice is given.6The local authority may extend the period for paying the fixed penalty in any particular case if they consider it appropriate to do so by sending notice to the person to whom the fixed penalty notice was given.7No proceedings for an offence under section 80(4) may be commenced before the end of the period for payment of the fixed penalty.8In proceedings for an offence under section 80(4), a certificate which—apurports to be signed by or on behalf of a person having responsibility for the financial affairs of the local authority; andbsuch other persons,as the Scottish Ministers consider appropriate..4In section 81 (supplementary provisions), for subsection (3), substitute—3Where an abatement notice has not been complied with, the local authority may, whether or not—aproceedings have been taken for an offence under section 80(4); orba fixed penalty notice has been given under section 80(4A) in respect of that offence (regardless of whether the fixed penalty notice is accepted),abate the nuisance and do whatever may be necessary in execution of the abatement notice..

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/a" id="regulation-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1), after the definition of “mine” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“mutagen” means a substance or preparation which if classified in accordance with the classification provided for by regulation 4 of the CHIP Regulations would be in the category of danger, mutagenic (category 1) or mutagenic (category 2) whether or not the substance or preparation would be required to be classified under those Regulations;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/b" id="regulation-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 7(5) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/b/i" id="regulation-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the word “carcinogen” there shall be added the words “or mutagen”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/b/ii" id="regulation-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in each place where it occurs, after the word “carcinogens” there shall be added the words “or mutagens”.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/c" id="regulation-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 13(4), for the words “a carcinogen or a biological agent” there shall be substituted the words “a carcinogen, a mutagen or a biological agent”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/288/regulation/2/d" id="regulation-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of Schedule 1 there shall be added the following substances –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1para>
<Text>The following polychlorodibenzodioxins:</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>2, 3, 7, 8-TCDD</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 7, 8-PeCDD</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8-HxCDD</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8-HxCDD</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9-HxCDD</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8-HpCDD</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>OCDD.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
<P1para>
<Text>The following polychlorodibenzofurans:</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>2, 3, 7, 8-TCDF</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>2, 3, 4, 7, 8-PeCDF</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 7, 8-PeCDF</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8-HxCDF</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9-HxCDF</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8-HxCDF</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8-HxCDF</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8-HpCDF</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9-HpCDF</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>OCDF</Text>

</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>where T = tetra, Pe = penta, Hx = hexa, Hp = hepta and O = octa.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>

<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>

law.title: Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423" NumberOfProvisions="24" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/body" NumberOfProvisions="15" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1993</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1993<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> shall be amended –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/a" id="regulation-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by substituting for sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) of paragraph (3) of regulation 4 the following sub-paragraphs –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it is appropriate for the risk or risks involved, the conditions at the place where exposure to such risk or risks may occur, and the period for which it is worn;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it takes account of ergonomic requirements and the state of health of the person or persons who may wear it, and of the characteristics of the workstation of each such person;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/b" id="regulation-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by adding to regulation 4 the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where it is necessary to ensure that personal protective equipment is hygienic and otherwise free of risk to health, every employer and every self-employed person shall ensure that personal protective equipment provided is provided to a person for use only by him.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c" id="regulation-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) of regulation 6 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/i" id="regulation-5-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by deleting the word “and” after sub-paragraph (b);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/ii" id="regulation-5-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by substituting a semi-colon for the full stop at the end of sub-paragraph (c) and after that by adding the word “and”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/iii" id="regulation-5-c-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by adding after sub-paragraph (c) the following sub-paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an assessment as to whether the personal protective equipment is compatible with other personal protective equipment which is in use and which an employee would be required to wear simultaneously.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d" id="regulation-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1) of regulation 9 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/i" id="regulation-5-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by substituting a comma for the full stop at the end of sub-paragraph (c); and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/ii" id="regulation-5-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by adding after sub-paragraph (c) the words “and shall ensure that such information is kept available to employees.”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/e" id="regulation-5-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by adding after paragraph (2) of regulation 9 the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1) the employer shall, where appropriate, and at suitable intervals, organise demonstrations in the wearing of personal protective equipment.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
