<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2007/268/article/11/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2007/268/article/11/1" id="article-11-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Environmental Impact Assessment (Scotland) Regulations 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/> are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2007/268/article/11/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2007/268/article/11/2" id="article-11-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1) (interpretation)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2007/268/article/11/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2007/268/article/11/2/a" id="article-11-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “exempt development”, insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“fish farming” means the breeding, rearing or keeping of fish, excluding shellfish;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“fish farm development” means the placing or assembly of any equipment in marine waters for the purposes of fish farming (“equipment” having the same meaning as in section 26(6) of the Act) and any material change of use of equipment so placed or assembled;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText> and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2007/268/article/11/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2007/268/article/11/2/b" id="article-11-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “the land” insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“marine waters” means the waters described in paragraphs (b) and (c) of subsection (6) of section 26 of the Act</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2007/268/article/11/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2007/268/article/11/3" id="article-11-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 28A (ROMP applications) insert–</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

the development management procedure reg.title: Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (Scotland) Regulations 2008

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221" NumberOfProvisions="4" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/body" NumberOfProvisions="4"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Environmental Impact Assessment (Scotland) Regulations 1999</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to regulation 3, the 1999 Regulations are amended in accordance with paragraphs (2) to (17).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2 (interpretation)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1)–</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/i" id="regulation-2-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “application for multi-stage consent” for “of reserved matters” substitute “, consent or agreement required by a condition imposed on a grant of planning permission in principle”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/ii" id="regulation-2-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “the consultation bodies”, insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (Scotland) Regulations 2008 (S.S.I. 2008/432)">Development Management Procedure Regulations</Abbreviation>” means the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (Scotland) Regulations 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/iii" id="regulation-2-2-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>omit the definition of “general development order”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/iv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/iv" id="regulation-2-2-a-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for the definition of “outline planning permission” substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“planning permission in principle” has the meaning given in section 59 of the Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/v" id="regulation-2-2-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “project” for “outline planning permission” in both places where those words occur substitute “planning permission in principle”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/vi/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/vi" id="regulation-2-2-a-vi">
<Pnumber>vi</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “reporter” omit the words “or 130” in both places where they occur;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/vii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/vii" id="regulation-2-2-a-vii">
<Pnumber>vii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>omit the definition of “reserved matters”.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (5) insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations, references to a relevant planning authority shall, as regards an application being considered on review under section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions) be construed as including a reference to the planning authority acting by virtue of that section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3(1) (prohibition on granting planning permission without consideration of environmental information) omit from the word “and” to “order” inclusive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3A(2) (consideration of environmental information: multi stage consent) for “outline planning permission” substitute “planning permission in principle”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5" id="regulation-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 7(5) (application made to planning authority without an environmental statement)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/a" id="regulation-2-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit paragraph (a); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/b" id="regulation-2-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (b) at the end insert “or a review by virtue of section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions)”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/6" id="regulation-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 9(5) (appeal to the Scottish Ministers without an environmental statement) omit “and comply with regulation 13(3)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/7" id="regulation-2-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 9, insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Review by the planning authority of an application without an environmental statement</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>9A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where on consideration of a review under section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions) it appears to the planning authority that–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the relevant application is a Schedule 2 application;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the development in question has not been the subject of a screening opinion or screening direction; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the relevant application is not accompanied by a statement referred to by the appellant as an environmental statement for the purposes of these Regulations,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>paragraphs (3) and (4) of regulation 5 shall apply as if the requirement to review the case under section 43A(8) were a request made by the applicant pursuant to regulation 5(1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where it appears to the planning authority that the relevant application is an <Acronym Expansion="Environmental Impact Assessment">EIA</Acronym> application and is not accompanied by a statement referred to by the applicant as an environmental statement for the purposes of these Regulations, they shall notify the applicant in writing that the submission of an environmental statement is required.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An applicant receiving a notification pursuant to paragraph (2) may, within three weeks beginning with the date of the notification, write to the planning authority–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>stating that the applicant accepts their view and is providing an environmental statement; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>unless the Scottish Ministers have made a screening direction in respect of the development, stating that the applicant is writing to the Scottish Ministers to request a screening direction.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If the applicant does not write to the planning authority in accordance with paragraph (3), the permission sought shall, unless the Scottish Ministers have made a screening direction to the effect that the development is not EIA development, be deemed to be refused at the end of the relevant three week period, and the deemed refusal shall not give rise to an appeal to the Scottish Ministers by virtue of section 47 (right to appeal against planning decisions and failure to take such decisions).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A planning authority which has given a notification in accordance with paragraph (2) shall, unless the Scottish Ministers make a screening direction to the effect that the development is not EIA development, determine the relevant application only by refusing planning permission if the applicant does not submit an environmental statement.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A person who requests a screening direction pursuant to sub-paragraph (3)(b) shall send to the Scottish Ministers with that request copies of–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the application for planning permission;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>all documents sent to the authority as part of the application; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>all correspondence between the applicant and the authority relating to the proposed development,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and paragraphs (2) to (5) of regulation 6 shall apply to a request under this regulation as they apply to a request made pursuant to regulation 5(6).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This regulation shall not apply where regulation 21B applies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/8" id="regulation-2-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 12(3)(b) (procedure to facilitate preparation of environmental statements) for “or 9(3)” substitute “, 9(3) or 9A(3)(a)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9" id="regulation-2-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 13 (publicity for environmental statement)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/a" id="regulation-2-9-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1) for “he shall serve on any party who holds a notifiable interest in neighbouring land a notice” substitute “the authority to whom the statement is submitted must give notice in accordance with paragraph (1A)”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/b" id="regulation-2-9-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (1) insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Notice under paragraph (1) is to be given where there are premises situated on the neighbouring land to which the notice can be sent to the owner, lessee or occupier of such premises, by sending a notice addressed to “the Owner, Lessee or Occupier” to such premises.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/c" id="regulation-2-9-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit paragraphs (2) to (4); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/d" id="regulation-2-9-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (7) for “article 2(1) of the general development order” substitute “regulation 3(1) of the Development Management Procedure Regulations”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/10" id="regulation-2-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 14(1) (consultation where environmental statement received) after “EIA application” insert “(including an EIA application under consideration on review under section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions))”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11" id="regulation-2-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 21B(1) (application for multi-stage consent without environmental statement)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/a" id="regulation-2-11-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (a) for “relates to outline” substitute “(including determination following consideration of the application on review under section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions)) relates to”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/b" id="regulation-2-11-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (c) omit “outline”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/12" id="regulation-2-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 21C(1)(a) and (c) (application for multi-stage consent referred to the Scottish Ministers without environmental statement), 21D(1)(a) (appeal in respect of application for multi stage consent without environmental statement) and 21H(a)(ii) and (j) (procedure for application for multi-stage consent), omit “outline”, wherever that word occurs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/13" id="regulation-2-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 21E(1) (application for multi-stage consent with environmental statement) at the end of paragraph (b) insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default">
<P3para>
<Text>; or</Text>
</P3para>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the relevant planning authority have under consideration on review under section 43A(8) an application for multi-stage consent where an environmental statement has already been submitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/14" id="regulation-2-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 21G (procedure to facilitate preparation of environmental statements) for paragraph (b) substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>

<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>

<P3para>

<P3para>

</P3>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17/a" id="regulation-2-17-a">

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168" NumberOfProvisions="6" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/body" NumberOfProvisions="6"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Electricity Works (Environmental Impact Assessment) (Scotland) Regulations 2017</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Electricity Works (Environmental Impact Assessment) (Scotland) Regulations 2017<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> are amended in accordance with paragraphs (2) to (18).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 4 (environmental impact assessment)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)(b) for “wild flora” substitute “of wild fauna and flora”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (6)(b) for “that the” substitute “that”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 9(4)(a)(i) (screening opinions – time period for decision) for “if earlier of” substitute “if earlier” and for “views of the planning authority” substitute “views of the planning authority)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 11(1) (<Acronym Expansion="Environmental Impact Assessment">EIA</Acronym> application made without an EIA report) omit “a report referred to by the developer as”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/5" id="regulation-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 13 (procedure to facilitate preparation of EIA reports)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/5/a" id="regulation-2-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) for “purpose, of ” substitute “purpose of,”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/5/b" id="regulation-2-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (5)(b) for “11(1)” substitute “11(2)”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/6" id="regulation-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 14(2)(g) (publication of EIA report) for “the how” substitute “how”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/7" id="regulation-2-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 18(1) (copies of EIA report for the public) for “21(1)” substitute “14(1)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/8" id="regulation-2-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 19(4) (additional information and evidence relating to EIA reports) omit “it”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/9" id="regulation-2-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 20 (publication of additional information)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/9/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/9/a" id="regulation-2-9-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)(c) after “inspection” where it first occurs insert “free of charge”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/9/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/9/b" id="regulation-2-9-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (6) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where additional information is provided to the Scottish Ministers the developer must ensure that a reasonable number of copies of the additional information are available for inspection at any place named in the notice under paragraph (1) as a place at which copies of the additional information may be inspected.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The developer must provide copies of the additional information in accordance with the terms of the notice under paragraph (1) and where that notice includes an address at which copies of the additional information may be obtained the developer must ensure that a reasonable number of copies of the additional information are available at that address.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/10" id="regulation-2-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 21(5) (decision notice)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/10/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/10/a" id="regulation-2-10-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (a) of the definition of “mitigation measures” for “planning permission” substitute “Electricity Act consent or a condition subject to which any planning permission is deemed to be granted by virtue of a direction given under section 57(2) or (2ZA) of the 1997 Act”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/10/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/10/b" id="regulation-2-10-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “monitoring measures” for “by virtue of” to the end of that definition substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P3para><Text>by virtue of—</Text>
</P3para>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a condition imposed on the grant of Electricity Act consent or a condition subject to which any planning permission is deemed to be granted by virtue of a direction given under section 57(2) or (2ZA) of the 1997 Act; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a planning obligation;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/11" id="regulation-2-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 27(1) (modification of regulations relating to applications for multi-stage consent) omit “references” where it first occurs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/12" id="regulation-2-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 28(2)(a)(iii) (application of regulations to variation applications) for “references if they are” substitute “if they are references”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/13" id="regulation-2-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 29(3) (development in Scotland likely to have significant effects in an <Acronym Expansion="European Economic Area">EEA</Acronym> state other than the United Kingdom) for “(2)(c)” substitute “(2)(a)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/14" id="regulation-2-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 30 (projects in another EEA state likely to have significant transboundary effects)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/14/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/14/a" id="regulation-2-14-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1)(c) for “those authorities” substitute “the consultation bodies”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/14/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/14/b" id="regulation-2-14-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) omit “, insofar as they are concerned,”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/15" id="regulation-2-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 34 (service of notices <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>) for “30 to 32” substitute “31 to 33”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/16/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/16" id="regulation-2-16">
<Pnumber>16</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 39 (offences by bodies corporate etc.)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/16/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/16/a" id="regulation-2-16-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1) for “Subsection” substitute “Paragraph”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/16/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/16/b" id="regulation-2-16-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3) for “subsection” substitute “paragraph”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/17/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/17" id="regulation-2-17">
<Pnumber>17</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 40(2) (transitional provisions – general) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Paragraphs (1) to (3) of regulation 20 (publication of additional information) do not apply to additional information falling within paragraph (b) of the definition of “additional information” in regulation 2(1) which is received by the Scottish Ministers in relation to an application for Electricity Act consent before 16th May 2017 where before that date notice has been given under regulation 14A(2) of the 2000 Regulations in relation to that application.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18" id="regulation-2-18">
<Pnumber>18</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In schedule 4 (information for inclusion in environmental impact assessment reports)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18/a" id="regulation-2-18-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 1(d) for “radiation” substitute “radiation)”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18/b" id="regulation-2-18-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 5 for “92/43/<Acronym Expansion="European Economic Community">EEC</Acronym>3” substitute “92/43/EEC”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18/c" id="regulation-2-18-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 8 for “this Directive” substitute “the Directive”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/168/regulation/2/18/d" id="regulation-2-18-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 9 for “points” substitute “paragraphs”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2019/178/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2019/178" NumberOfProvisions="3" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2019/178/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2019/178/body" NumberOfProvisions="3"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2019/178/part/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2019/178/part/2" NumberOfProvisions="1" id="part-2"><Number>PART 2</Number><Title>Amendment of the Act to update legislative references, made in exercise of powers conferred by section 2(2) of the European Communities Act 1972</Title><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Act to update references</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Act is amended in accordance with paragraphs (2) to (4).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 5(3)(b) (qualifying plans and programmes), for “Council <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1997/0062" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1997" Number="0062">Directive 97/62/EC</Citation>” substitute “Council <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2013/0017" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2013" Number="0017">Directive 2013/17/EU</Citation><FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In schedule 1 (projects)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/3/a" id="regulation-2-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 9—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/3/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2019/178/regulation/2/3/a/i" id="regulation-2-3-a-i">

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165" NumberOfProvisions="518" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2026-03-26"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/body" NumberOfProvisions="53" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-11-01"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/part/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/part/2" NumberOfProvisions="46" id="part-2" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-11-01"><Number>PART 2</Number><Title>Amendment of the 2018 Regulations</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-06-01"><Title>Amendment of regulation 60 (power of SEPA to impose authorisations)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/29" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/29" id="regulation-29">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-53298d"/>29</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 60 (power of SEPA to impose authorisations)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/29/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/29/a" id="regulation-29-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3), for “or” substitute <InlineAmendment>“and”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/29/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/29/b" id="regulation-29-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (4), after (1), insert <InlineAmendment>“(b) or (c)”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/29/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/29/c" id="regulation-29-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (4), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where SEPA treats an activity in accordance with paragraph (1), the person or persons it considers to be in control of the carrying on of the activity are to be treated for the purposes of these Regulations as—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to treatment as a notification, the person who makes a notification in accordance with regulation 12(3),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to treatment as a permit or registration, the applicant.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165" NumberOfProvisions="518" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2026-03-26"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/body" NumberOfProvisions="53" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-11-01"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/part/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/part/2" NumberOfProvisions="46" id="part-2" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-11-01"><Number>PART 2</Number><Title>Amendment of the 2018 Regulations</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-11-01"><Title>Amendment of schedule 1 (registrations and permits: procedures)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35" id="regulation-35">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-70e74e"/>35</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In schedule 1(registrations and permits: procedures)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/a" id="regulation-35-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before paragraph 1, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>
<Title>Pre-application community engagement</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA may require a person who intends to apply for a permit or a variation to an existing permit to consult with members of the public likely to be affected by the proposed activity or variation.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA may require that person to take such steps as SEPA considers appropriate.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/b" id="regulation-35-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph 2(1)(b), before “and” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P3>
<Pnumber>ca</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any information relating to pre-application community engagement required by SEPA under paragraph 1A.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c" id="regulation-35-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 4—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c/i" id="regulation-35-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>renumber the existing provision as sub-paragraph (1),</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c/ii" id="regulation-35-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (1) as renumbered, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where an application is modified by the applicant, any fee payable under a charging scheme for the modification of an application is payable by the applicant.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d" id="regulation-35-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 7(3)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d/i" id="regulation-35-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in head (b), for “has the potential”, substitute <InlineAmendment>“is likely”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d/ii" id="regulation-35-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in head (c), at the end, insert, <InlineAmendment>“having regard to the public participation statement”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e" id="regulation-35-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 8—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/i" id="regulation-35-e-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (1)(d), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the times and places where, or the means by which, public consultees may access copies of the application, proposed SEPA initiated variation and any other relevant information required to be publicised.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/ii" id="regulation-35-e-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (2), omit “(a) or (b)”,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/iii" id="regulation-35-e-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (3), omit “further”,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/f" id="regulation-35-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 12, omit sub-paragraphs (1)(c) and (2),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/g" id="regulation-35-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 13, after sub-paragraph (2), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where SEPA issues a SEPA initiated variation notice under regulation 25, any fee payable under a charging scheme for the variation is payable by the authorised person.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/h" id="regulation-35-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 14(3), omit “on the date specified in the notice and”,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i" id="regulation-35-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 15—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/i" id="regulation-35-i-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for sub-paragraph (1)(a)(v), substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P4>
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>remove any equipment, plant, articles, waste (including radioactive waste) or substances associated with the activity which adversely affect the amenity of the authorised place and surrounding area or otherwise take steps to preserve the amenity of the authorised place or surrounding area,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/ii" id="regulation-35-i-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (1)(b)(i) and (ii), after “effect”, insert <InlineAmendment>“in whole or in part”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/iii" id="regulation-35-i-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (5)(b) for “applicant” substitute <InlineAmendment>“authorised person”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/j" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/j" id="regulation-35-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 16—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/j/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/j/i" id="regulation-35-j-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for sub-paragraph (1)(a)(v), substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P4>
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>remove any equipment, plant, articles, waste (including radioactive waste) or substances associated with the activity which adversely affect the amenity of the authorised place and surrounding area or otherwise take steps to preserve the amenity of the authorised place or surrounding area,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/j/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/j/ii" id="regulation-35-j-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (1)(d)(i), for “or” substitute <InlineAmendment>“and”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/j/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/j/iii" id="regulation-35-j-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (2), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA may impose an off-site condition in a revocation notice.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/k" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/k" id="regulation-35-k">
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 18(b), at the end, omit—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P3para>
<Text>,</Text>
<Text>in respect of which a third party representation has been made</Text>
</P3para>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/l" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/l" id="regulation-35-l">
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph 19(1), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Scottish Ministers must consult SEPA before issuing a direction under sub-paragraph (1),</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/m" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/m" id="regulation-35-m">
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit paragraphs 20 to 22,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/n" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/n" id="regulation-35-n">
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 24, omit the definition of “third party representation”,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/o" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/o" id="regulation-35-o">
<Pnumber>o</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph 24, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">25</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This paragraph applies to a function of the Scottish Ministers in connection with a matter referred to them for determination in compliance of a direction made under paragraph 19(1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this paragraph applies, the Scottish Ministers may—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>appoint a person to exercise any such function on their behalf, with or without payment,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>refer a matter to a person they may appoint for the purpose, with or without payment.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-70e74e"/>35</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In schedule 1(registrations and permits: procedures)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/a" id="regulation-35-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before paragraph 1, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>

<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA may require a person who intends to apply for a permit or a variation to an existing permit to consult with members of the public likely to be affected by the proposed activity or variation.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA may require that person to take such steps as SEPA considers appropriate.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/b" id="regulation-35-b">

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165" NumberOfProvisions="518" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2026-03-26"><Secondary><Schedules RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2026-03-26"><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/schedule/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/schedule/1" NumberOfProvisions="7" id="schedule-1" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-11-01">
<Number><CommentaryRef Ref="key-2fade6"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-2e5db0"/>SCHEDULE 1</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>NEW SCHEDULE 10 TO BE INSERTED INTO THE 2018 REGULATIONS</Title>
</TitleBlock>

<ScheduleBody>
<BlockAmendment Context="schedule" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<Schedule>
<Number>SCHEDULE<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>10</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>WATER ACTIVITIES</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Regulation 6(1)</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<Part>
<Number>PART<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1</Number>
<Title>Scope and Interpretation</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Scope</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This schedule applies to all water activities,</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph 2 applies for the interpretation of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>this schedule,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>schedule 9,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definitions of water environment and water activity.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The water environment includes any part of the water environment which is for the time being dry.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The water environment does not include any water contained in—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>artificial swimming pools,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>mains or other pipes belonging to Scottish Water or which are used by Scottish Water or any other person for the purpose only of providing a supply of water to any premises,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>water treatment works,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sewers and drains which drain into sewers,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sewage treatment works,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>artificially created systems for the treatment of pollutants.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>“<Term>Water activity</Term>” does not include the discharge of any reagent or chemical or particle tracer used in connection with any scientific experiment or survey in transitional water or coastal water.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>
<Part>
<Number>PART<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2</Number>
<Title>Amendments to common framework provisions</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Authorisation conditions: protection of the water environment</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA must ensure that an authorisation for a water activity includes such conditions as it considers necessary or expedient for the purposes of protection of the water environment.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this paragraph, “<Term>protection of the water environment</Term>” includes, in particular—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>preventing further deterioration of, and protecting and enhancing, the status of aquatic ecosystems and, with regard to their water needs, terrestrial ecosystems and wetlands directly depending on those aquatic ecosystems,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>promoting sustainable water use based on the long-term protection of available resources,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>enhancing protection and improvement of the aquatic environment.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Authorised person in relation to a private sewage activity</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This paragraph applies in relation to authorisations for the carrying on of a private sewage activity except where—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the authorisation provides for the carrying on of any other regulated activity in addition to the carrying on of a private sewage activity, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>SEPA considers it appropriate to authorise the carrying on of a particular private sewage activity by permit.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The “<Term>authorised person</Term>” in relation to that activity is the owner of any land from which domestic sewage is or is to be discharged into a private sewage treatment works.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The definition of authorised person in paragraph (2) includes—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where an authorised person has been adjudged bankrupt or the estate of the authorised person is sequestrated, the trustee in bankruptcy,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where an executor has been appointed to an authorised person’s estate, the executor,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where the authorised person is a body corporate, and—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>a receiver has been appointed, the receiver,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>an administrator has been appointed, the administrator,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>a liquidator has been appointed, the liquidator,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where an authorised person is a partnership which is dissolved, any person who was a partner immediately before dissolution.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions do not apply in relation to the authorisation of, or carrying on of, a private sewage activity to which this paragraph applies—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 5 (interpretation: authorised person),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 12(3)(a) (notifications),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 16 (application for a registration),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 17(1)(b) (form and content of a registration),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 18(3) (grant of registration),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 19(2)(a) (variation of registrations: purposes),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 19(3) (variation of registrations: authorised person),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 27 (transfer of a registration or permit),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 28 (effect of transfer),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 29 (transfer of revocation notice),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 30(1)(c) (surrender of registration or permit).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The notification of the carrying on or the proposed carrying on of a private sewage activity to which this paragraph applies under regulation 12 must be made by the authorised person.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An application to SEPA for a registration for the carrying on of a private sewage activity to which this paragraph applies must be made in accordance with schedule 1 by the authorised person.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulation 46 (regulatory notices) applies in relation to a private sewage activity to which this paragraph applies in accordance with the following modifications—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 46(1) and (2) are to be read as if there were substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">46</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This regulation applies where SEPA is of the opinion that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a private sewage activity has been or is being carried on, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at least one of the following apply—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>steps are required to be taken to prevent or mitigate environmental harm caused or likely to be caused by the private sewage activity,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>steps are required to be taken to restore the environment affected or likely to be affected by the regulated activity,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the authorised person has contravened, is contravening, or is likely to contravene a condition, or other provision, of a registration or a general binding rule,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the authorised person has committed an offence under these Regulations,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this regulation applies, SEPA may serve a notice (a “regulatory notice”) on the authorised person.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 46(3) is to be read as if sub-paragraphs (f) and (g)(v) were omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulation 60 (power of SEPA to impose authorisations) applies in relation to a private sewage activity to which this paragraph applies in accordance with the following modifications—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 60(1), the reference to “regulated activity” is to be read as if there were substituted “private sewage activity”,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 60(3) and (4) are to be read as if there were substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA must give notice to the authorised person carrying on the private sewage activity that it is treating the activity in accordance with paragraph (1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where SEPA treats an activity in accordance with paragraph 60(1), SEPA must grant an authorisation to the authorised person.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulation 63(6)(b) (accelerated applications) does not apply in relation to a private sewage activity to which this paragraph applies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any regulatory notice, revocation notice or surrender notice in force in respect of a registration authorising the carrying on of a private sewage activity to which this paragraph applies must be complied with by the authorised person for that activity.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA may not revoke an existing water registration on the ground that SEPA considers that the authorised person is not in control of the carrying on of the activity in relation to a private sewage activity.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this paragraph—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“domestic sewage” and “private sewage treatment works” have the meanings given in section 59 of the Sewerage (Scotland) Act 1968<FootnoteRef Ref="f00027"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“<Term>private sewage activity</Term>” means the discharge of domestic sewage, whether treated or untreated, from a private sewage treatment works.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>
<Part>
<Number>PART<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>3</Number>
<Title>Duties on SEPA</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Duties: general</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before carrying out a function mentioned in sub-paragraph (2) in respect of a water activity, SEPA must—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if it considers that the activity has or is likely to have a significant adverse impact on the water environment—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>assess the indirect effects of that impact on any other aspects of the environment likely to be significantly affected,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>consider any likely adverse social and economic effects of that impact and of any indirect environmental effects identified in accordance with sub-paragraph (i),</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>consider the likely environmental, social and economic benefits of the activity,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>assess the impact of the activity on the interests of other users of the water environment,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>have regard to other water activities being carried on or likely to be carried on in the area.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The functions mentioned are—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>granting, or refusing to grant, a registration or a permit,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>varying, or refusing to vary, a registration or a permit.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Duties: environmental objectives</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA must carry out its relevant functions in relation to water activities to secure—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the achievement of the environmental objectives set for water bodies under section 9(1)(a)(i) (environmental objectives) of the Water Environment and Water Services (Scotland) Act 2003(“<Term>the 2003 Act</Term>”)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00028"/> and in accordance with regulations 3, 5 to 10 and 17 of the 2013 Regulations,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the achievement of the environmental objectives set for shellfish water protected areas under section 9(1)(a)(ii) of the 2003 Act and in accordance with regulations 3 and 4 to 7 of the Water Environment (Shellfish Water Protected Areas: Environmental Objectives etc.) (Scotland) Regulations 2013<FootnoteRef Ref="f00029"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the achievement of the protection of the bodies of water identified under section 6(1) (bodies of water used for the abstraction of drinking water) of the 2003 Act, with the aim of avoiding deterioration in the quality of that body of water in order to reduce the level of purification treatment required in the production of drinking water,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the achievement of the environmental objectives set for the Solway Tweed River Basin District under paragraph 6 of schedule 1 of the Water Environment (Water Framework Directive) (Solway Tweed River Basin District) Regulations 2004<FootnoteRef Ref="f00030"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the achievement of the environmental objectives set for the Northumbria River Basin District by regulation 5 of the Water Environment (Water Framework Directive) (Northumbria River Basin District) Regulations 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00031"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>compliance with the relevant requirements of regulations 13(3), 17, 18, 23(2) and 24 of the 2013 Regulations and regulation 9(2) of the Water Environment (Shellfish Water Protected Areas: Environmental Objectives etc.)(Scotland) Regulations 2013<FootnoteRef Ref="f00032"/>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA must in exercising its relevant functions in relation to water activities, have regard to the requirements of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Urban Waste Water Treatment (Scotland) Regulations 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00033"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Conservation (Natural Habitats, &c.) Regulations 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00034"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 2 of the Nature Conservation (Scotland) Act 2004<FootnoteRef Ref="f00035"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Bathing Waters (Scotland) Regulations 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00036"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 15(1) of the Marine (Scotland) Act 2010<FootnoteRef Ref="f00037"/>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule>

</ScheduleBody>
