<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165" NumberOfProvisions="518" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2026-03-26"><Secondary><Schedules RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2026-03-26"><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/schedule/18" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/schedule/18" NumberOfProvisions="16" id="schedule-18" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-11-01">
<Number><CommentaryRef Ref="key-9f3ae0"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-3439a6"/>SCHEDULE 18</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>NEW SCHEDULE 27 TO BE INSERTED INTO THE REGULATIONS</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Regulation 9(2)</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<BlockAmendment Context="schedule" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<Schedule>
<Number>SCHEDULE<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>27</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>OPERATING A MEDIUM COMBUSTION PLANT</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Regulation 6(1)</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<Part>
<Number>PART<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1</Number>
<Title>Scope and Interpretation</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Scope</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Schedule applies to operating a medium combustion plant.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Interpretation: operating a medium combustion plant</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this schedule, “<Term>operating a medium combustion plant</Term>” means operating a combustion plant with a rated thermal input equal to or greater than 1 megawatt and less than 50 megawatts but does not include the activities in sub-paragraph (2).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The excluded activities are the operation of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a large combustion plant,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a waste incineration or waste co-incineration plant,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>combustion plants covered by EU Regulation 2016/1628 on requirements relating to gaseous and particulate pollutant emission limits and type-approval for internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery<FootnoteRef Ref="f00088"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>on-farm combustion plants with a total rated thermal input less than or equal to 5 megawatts, that exclusively use unprocessed poultry manure, as referred to in Article 9(a) of EU Regulation No. 1069/2009 of the European Parliament and Council laying down health rules as regards animal by-products and derived products not intended for human consumption and repealing Regulation <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/regulation/2002/1774" id="c00050" Year="2002" Number="1774" Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation">(EC) No 1774/2002</Citation>, as a fuel<FootnoteRef Ref="f00089"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>combustion plants in which the gaseous products of combustion are used for the direct heating, drying or any other treatment of objects or materials,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>combustion plants in which the gaseous products of combustion are used for direct gas-fired heating used to heat indoor spaces for the purpose of improving workplace conditions,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>post-combustion plants designed to purify the waste gases from industrial processes by combustion and which are not operated as independent combustion plants,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any technical apparatus used in the propulsion of a vehicle, ship or aircraft,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>gas turbines and gas and diesel engines, when used on offshore platforms,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>facilities for the regeneration of catalytic cracking catalysts,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>facilities for the conversion of hydrogen sulphide into sulphur,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>reactors used in the chemical industry,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>coke battery furnaces,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>cowpers,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>o</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>crematoria,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>p</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>combustion plants firing refinery fuels alone or with other fuels for the production of energy within mineral oil and gas refineries,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>q</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>recovery boilers within installations for the production of pulp.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Operating a medium combustion plant does not include research activities, development activities or testing activities relating to medium combustion plants.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Interpretation: general</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this schedule—</Text>
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>biomass</Term>” has the meaning given in paragraph 3(1) of schedule 19 of these Regulations,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>diesel engine</Term>” has the meaning given in paragraph 2 of schedule 21 of these Regulations,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>dual fuel engine</Term>” means an internal combustion engine that uses compression ignition and operates according to the Diesel cycle when burning liquid fuels, and according to the Otto cycle when burning gaseous fuels,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>dust</Term>” means particles, of any shape, structure or density, dispersed in the gas phase at the sampling point conditions, which may be collected by filtration under specified conditions after representative sampling of the gas to be analysed, and that remain upstream of the filter and on the filter after drying under specified conditions,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>emission</Term>” means the discharge of substances from a combustion plant into the air,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>engine</Term>” means a gas engine, diesel engine or dual fuel engine,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>existing medium combustion plant</Term>” means a medium combustion plant put into operation on or before 20 December 2018,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>gas engine</Term>” means an internal combustion engine that operates according to the Otto cycle and uses spark ignition to burn fuel,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>gas oil</Term>” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>any petroleum-derived liquid fuel falling within CN codes 2710 19 25, 2710 19 29, 2710 19 47, 2710 19 48, 2710 20 17 or 2710 20 19, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>any petroleum-derived liquid fuel of which less than 65% by volume (including losses) distils at 250°C and of which at least 85% by volume (including losses) distils at 350°C by the ASTM D86 method,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>gas turbine</Term>” means any rotating machine which converts thermal energy into mechanical work, consisting mainly of a compressor, a thermal device in which fuel is oxidised in order to heat the working fluid, and a turbine,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>heavy fuel oil</Term>” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>any petroleum-derived liquid fuel falling within CN codes 2710 19 51 to 2710 19 68, 2710 20 31, 2710 20 35, or 2710 20 39,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>any petroleum-derived liquid fuel, other than gas oil, which, by reason of its distillation limits, falls within the category of heavy oils intended for use as fuel and of which less than 65% by volume (including losses) distils at 250°C by the ASTM D86 method, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>any petroleum product for which distillation cannot be determined by the ASTM D86 method,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>micro-isolated system</Term>” (MIS) means any electricity system with consumption less than 500 GWh in the year 1996 where there is no connection with other systems,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>natural gas</Term>” means naturally occurring methane with no more than 20% (by volume) of inerts and other constituents,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>new medium combustion plant</Term>” means a medium combustion plant other than an existing medium combustion plant,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>nitrogen oxides</Term>” (NO<Inferior>x</Inferior>) means nitric oxide and nitrogen dioxide, expressed as nitrogen dioxide (NO<Inferior>2</Inferior>),</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>operating hours</Term>” has the meaning given in paragraph 2 of schedule 21 of these Regulations,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>refinery fuel</Term>” means solid, liquid or gaseous combustible material from the distillation and conversion steps of the refining of crude oil, including refinery fuel gas, syngas, refinery oils and pet coke,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>small isolated system (SIS)</Term>” means any electricity system with consumption of less than 3000 GWh in the year 1996, where less than 5% of annual consumption is obtained through interconnection with other systems,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>stack</Term>” has the meaning given in paragraph 2 of schedule 21 of these Regulations,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>zone</Term>” means part of the territory of Scotland as determined by the Scottish Ministers under regulation 4 of the Air Quality Standards (Scotland) Regulations 2010<FootnoteRef Ref="f00090"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Aggregation</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A combination formed by two or more new medium combustion plants is considered to be a single medium combustion plant for the purposes of this schedule and their rated thermal input are added together for the purpose of calculating the total rated thermal input of the plant, where—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the waste gases of the plants are discharged through a common stack, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the opinion of SEPA, the waste gases of the plant could be discharged through a common stack, taking into account technical and economic factors.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>
<Part>
<Number>PART<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2</Number>
<Title>Amendments to common framework provisions</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Authorisations</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Operating a medium combustion plant may be authorised by permit, registration or notification.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An authorisation for operating a medium combustion plant must give effect to the provisions of this schedule.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Applications for medium combustion activity authorisations</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>An application for an authorisation and a notification for operating a medium combustion plant must include—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the name of the applicant and the address of the applicant’s registered or principal office,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the address of the plant (or site upon which the plant is located),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the rated thermal input (in megawatts) of the plant,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the type of medium combustion plant (diesel engine, gas turbine, dual fuel engine, other engine or other medium combustion plant),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the type and share of fuels used (according to the categories in Part 3 of this schedule),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the date of the start of the operation of the medium combustion plant or, where the exact date of the start of the operation is unknown, proof of the fact that the operation started before 20 December 2018,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the sector of activity of the medium combustion plant or the facility in which it is applied (SIC Code),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the expected number of annual operating hours of the medium combustion plant and average load in use,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if required for the purposes of an exemption from compliance with emission limit values, a declaration signed by the Authorised person that the plant will not be operated for more than 500 hours or 1000 hours per year (calculated as a rolling average over a period of 5 years) or 500 hours per year (calculated as a rolling average over a period of 3 years), as appropriate.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Emission limit values: calculation</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>All emission limit values set out in this schedule are to be calculated—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at a temperature of 273.15K,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at a pressure of 101.3kPa,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after correction for the water vapour content of the waste gases,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at a standardised O<Inferior>2</Inferior> content of—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>6% for medium combustion plants using solid fuels,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>3% for medium combustion plants, other than engines and gas turbines, using liquid and gaseous fuels,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>15% for engines and gas turbines.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Emission limit values: general</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The emissions into air of SO<Inferior>2</Inferior>, NO<Inferior>x</Inferior> and dust from an existing medium combustion plant with a rated thermal input greater than 5 megawatts must not exceed the emission limit values set out in—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Table 2, if the plant is not an engine or gas turbine,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Table 3 if the plant is an engine or gas turbine,</Text>
<Text>unless an exemption in paragraph 9 applies.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The emissions into air of SO<Inferior>2</Inferior>, NO<Inferior>x</Inferior> and dust from an existing medium combustion plant with a rated thermal input of less than or equal to 5 megawatts must not exceed the emission limit values set out in—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Table 1, if the plant is not an engine or gas turbine,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Table 3, if the plant is an engine or gas turbine,</Text>
<Text>unless an exemption in paragraphs 9 or 10 of this schedule applies.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The emissions into air of SO<Inferior>2</Inferior>, NO<Inferior>x</Inferior> and dust from a new medium combustion plant must not exceed the emission limit values set out in—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Table 4, if the plant is not an engine or gas turbine,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Table 5, if the plant is an engine or gas turbine.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In zones or parts of zones not compliant with the limit values set out in schedule 2 of the Air Quality Standards (Scotland) Regulations 2010<FootnoteRef Ref="f00091"/>, SEPA must consider setting stricter permit conditions for individual medium combustion plants than those required by this paragraph where, in the opinion of SEPA, applying such emission limit values would effectively contribute to a noticeable improvement of air quality.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In zones or parts of zones not compliant with the limit values set out in schedule 2 of the Air Quality Standards (Scotland) Regulations 2010, the Scottish Ministers may direct SEPA to include stricter emission limit values for individual medium combustion plants than those required by this paragraph, where, in the opinion of the Scottish Ministers, applying such emission limit values would effectively contribute to a noticeable improvement of air quality.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Emission limit values: existing medium combustion plant exemptions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An existing medium combustion plant is exempt from the requirements in paragraph 8(1) or (2) of this schedule if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the plant does not operate more than 500 hours per year (calculated as a rolling average over a period of 5 years), or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the plant does not operate more than 1000 hours per year (calculated as a rolling average over a period of 5 years) and the plant is operated in case of emergency or extraordinary circumstances for—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>backup power production on an island where the main power supply to that island is from the Scottish mainland, in the event of an interruption of the main power supply to an island, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>heat production in cases of exceptionally cold weather events.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An authorisation for medium combustion plant which—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>is exempt by sub-paragraph (1) from the requirements in paragraph 8(1) or (2) of this schedule, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>is firing solid fuels,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>must contain an emission limit value for dust of 200 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An existing medium combustion plant with a rated thermal input greater than 5 megawatts is exempt from the requirement in paragraph 8(1) of this schedule until 1 January 2030 where at least 50% of the useful heat production of the plant (calculated as a rolling average over of a period of 5 years) is delivered in the form of steam or hot water to a public network for district heating.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An authorisation for a medium combustion plant which is exempt by sub-paragraph (3) from the requirement in paragraph 8(1) must contain, where applicable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>emission limits values which do not exceed—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>1100 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior> for SO<Inferior>2</Inferior>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>150 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior> for dust,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>conditions that are necessary to ensure that—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>no significant pollution is caused,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>a high level of protection for the environment as a whole is achieved.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An existing medium combustion plant with a rated thermal input greater than 5 megawatts is exempt until 1 January 2030 from the requirement in paragraph 8(1) of this schedule to comply with the emission limit values for NO<Inferior>x</Inferior> in Table 3 where the plant is used to drive gas compressor stations required to ensure the safety and security of a national gas transmission system.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An existing medium combustion plant which is part of a small isolated system, or a micro isolated system is exempt from the requirements in paragraphs 8(1) and (2) until 1 January 2030.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Emission limit values: exemptions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A medium combustion plant is exempt until 1 January 2030 from the requirements in paragraph 8(1) or (2) to comply with an emission limit value for dust in Tables 1, 2, or 3 where—–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the plant fires solid biomass as its main fuel,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the plant is situated in a zone which conforms with the limit values set out in retained EU law implementing <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2008/0050" id="c00051" Year="2008" Number="50" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective">Directive 2008/50/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council on ambient air quality and cleaner air for Europe<FootnoteRef Ref="f00092"/>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An authorisation for a medium combustion plant which is exempt by sub-paragraph (1) from the requirements in paragraph 8(1) or (2) must contain—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>emission limit values which do not exceed 150 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior> for dust,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>conditions necessary to ensure that—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>no significant environmental harm is caused,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>a high level of protection for the environment as a whole is achieved.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A new medium combustion plant is exempt from the requirements in paragraph 8(3) where the plant does not operate more than 500 hours per year (calculated as a rolling average over a period of 3 years).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An authorisation for a plant which—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is exempt by sub-paragraph (3) from the requirements in paragraph 8(3) of this schedule, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is firing solid fuels</Text>
<Text>must contain an emission limit value for dust of 100 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Emission limit values: temporary exemptions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA may<Strong>,</Strong> on application of the authorised person, grant an exemption for a maximum period of 6 months from the requirements in paragraph 8 of this schedule to comply with an emission limit value for SO<Inferior>2</Inferior> where the medium combustion plant—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>normally uses low-sulphur fuel, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the authorised person is unable to comply with an emission limit value for SO<Inferior>2</Inferior> due to an interruption in the supply of low-sulphur fuel resulting from a serious shortage.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA may, on application of the authorised person, grant an exemption for a maximum period of 10 days from the requirements in paragraph 8 of this schedule where the plant—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>uses only gaseous fuels,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>has to resort exceptionally to the use of non-gaseous fuel due to a sudden interruption in the supply of gas, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>requires to be fitted with secondary abatement equipment due to the interruption.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An application for an exemption—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>under sub-paragraph (1), must be made to SEPA in writing,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>under sub-paragraph (2)—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>must be made immediately and in advance of the need to use other fuels,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>may be made in writing, or by other means,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>will be treated as an accelerated application for a variation under regulation 63 of these Regulations,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>will be determined by SEPA within the period as considered appropriate by SEPA in the circumstances.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA will notify the authorised person in writing of an exemption granted under sub-paragraph (3) where practicable to do so.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The period in sub-paragraph (2) may be extended where SEPA considers that the authorised person has demonstrated that a longer period is justified.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA must immediately inform the Scottish Ministers of any exemption granted under this paragraph.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Emission limit values: multiple fuels</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where a medium combustion plant simultaneously uses two or more fuels, the emission limit value for each pollutant is calculated by—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>taking the emission limit value in Table 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 for each fuel,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>determining the fuel-weighted emission limit value, which is obtained by multiplying the individual emission limit value in sub-paragraph (a) by the thermal input delivered by each fuel, and dividing the product of multiplication by the sum of the thermal inputs delivered by all fuels, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>aggregating the fuel-weighted emission limit values.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Emissions monitoring</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA must ensure that an authorisation for operating a medium combustion plant includes such conditions as it considers appropriate in an authorisation for a medium combustion activity to ensure that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where the plant is using more than one fuel type, emissions are monitored—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>while the fuel or fuel mix likely to result in the highest level of emissions is being fired, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>during a period, representative of normal operating conditions,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>all monitoring results are recorded and processed so as to enable verification of compliance with the applicable emission limit values,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a record or information is kept proving the effective continuous operation of any secondary abatement equipment in use at the plant,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the following are kept—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the authorisation and, where relevant, variations and related information,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 id="p00136">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the monitoring results and information referred to in sub-paragraphs (b) and (c),</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>a record of the plant’s operating hours if applicable for the purposes of paragraph 9(1) or 10(3),</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>a record of the type and quantities of fuel used in the plant,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>a record of any breakdown or malfunction of secondary abatement equipment,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>vi</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>a record of a breach of an emission limit value, and the measures taken by the authorised person to restore compliance,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the information referred to in head (d)(ii) to (vi) is kept for a period of at least 6 years.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Emissions are to be measured—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for medium combustion plants with a rated thermal input equal to or greater than 1 MW and less than or equal to 20 MW, at least every three years,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for all other medium combustion plants, annually,</Text>
<Text>unless sub-paragraph (3) applies.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This paragraph applies where a medium combustion plant is—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>exempt from the requirements of paragraph 8(1) or (2) by paragraph 9(1) of this schedule, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>exempt from the requirements of paragraph 8(3) by paragraph 10(3) of this schedule.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where sub-paragraph (3) applies, emissions must be measured at the most frequent of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for a medium combustion plant with a rated thermal input equal to or greater than 1 MW and less than or equal to 20 MW, after the elapse of three times the maximum permitted average annual operating hours,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for medium combustion plants with a rated thermal input greater than 20 MW, after the elapse of a period equal to the maximum average annual operating hours</Text>
<Text>and in either case, measurements must be taken at least every five years.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following emissions are to be measured—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>pollutants for which an emission limit value is included in this schedule relevant to the plant concerned, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>carbon monoxide.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The first measurement of emissions is taken within 4 months of either—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the grant of the authorisation,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the date of the start of operation of the plant.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where verified and approved of by SEPA, as an alternative to the requirements of sub-paragraphs (2) and (4), other procedures may be used to determine SO<Inferior>2</Inferior> emissions from the plant.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where emissions are required by SEPA to be measured continuously—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the measuring systems must be subject to checking by means of parallel measurements with the reference methods at least annually, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>results of the check are to be provided to SEPA.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Measurements must be taken when—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the plant is operating under stable conditions at a representative even load, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the plant is not starting-up or shutting down.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Sampling and analysis of polluting substances and measurements of process parameters are to be based on methods enabling reliable, representative and comparable results.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Periods of start-up and shut-down are as short as possible.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Compliance</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>SEPA must ensure that an authorisation for operating a medium combustion plant includes such conditions as it considers appropriate to ensure that in the event of a breach of conditions, the authorised person must—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>immediately inform SEPA,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>immediately take necessary measures to ensure that compliance is restored as soon as possible,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>immediately cease operation of the medium combustion plant in the event that the non-compliance causes a significant degradation of local air quality.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Compliance and measurement</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">15</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>SEPA must periodically check compliance with authorisation conditions and, in the case of notifications, the applicable general binding rules, including emission limit values.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of periodic measurements, an emission limit value is to be treated as being complied with if each of the series of measurements (or other procedures) do not exceed the emission limit value.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of continuous measurements, an emission limit value is to be treated as being complied with if the evaluation of the measurement results indicates, for operating hours within a calendar year, that all of the following conditions have been met—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>no validated monthly average value exceeds the emission limit value,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>no validated daily average value exceeds 110% of the emission limit value,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of plant composed only of boilers using coal, no validated daily average value exceeds 150% of the emission limit value,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>95% of all the validated hourly average values over the year do not exceed 200% of the emission limit value.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>At the emission limit value level, the values of the 95% confidence intervals of a single measured result must not exceed the following percentages of the emission limit values—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>10% for emissions of carbon monoxide,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>20% for emissions of sulphur dioxide,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>20% for emissions of nitrogen oxides,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>30% for dust.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The validated hourly and daily average values are determined from the measured valid hourly average values after having subtracted the value of the confidence interval specified in sub-paragraph (4).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A day is invalidated if more than three hourly average values are invalid due to malfunction or maintenance of the automated measuring system.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purpose of calculating average emission limit values the following periods are to be disregarded—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>periods of start-up and shut-down, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the periods referred to in paragraph 11 of this schedule.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Public requests for monitoring data</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">16</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>SEPA must exercise its functions under regulation 37 where a member of the public requests access to the matters listed in paragraph 13(1)(d)(ii) to (vi) unless that information is otherwise readily available to SEPA.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>

<ListItem>

<ListItem>

IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1972/28/body" NumberOfProvisions="11"><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1972/28/crossheading/amendments-of-factories-act-1961" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1972/28/crossheading/amendments-of-factories-act-1961" NumberOfProvisions="9" id="crossheading-amendments-of-factories-act-1961"><Title> Amendments of Factories Act 1961</Title><P1group><Title> Medical examinations of persons employed in factories. <CommentaryRef Ref="c822781"/></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1972/28/section/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1972/28/section/3" id="section-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P1para><Text>The Factories Act 1961 shall have effect as if the following section were inserted after section 10 thereof:—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P1group Layout="below"><Title/><P1><Pnumber PuncAfter="">10A</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If an employment medical adviser is of opinion that ther ought, on grounds mentioned in subsection (2) below, to be a medical examination of a person or persons employed in a factory, he may serve on the occupier of the factory a written notice stating that he is of that opinion and requiring that the occupier shall permit a medical examination in accordance with this section of the person or persons in question, and the examination shall be permitted accordingly.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The grounds on which a medical examination of a person may be required by an employment medical adviser’s notice under subsection (1) above are that (in the adviser’s opinion) the persons health has been or is being injured, or it is possible that it has been, is being or will be injured, by reason of the nature of the work he is or has been called upon to do or may (to the adviser’s knowledge) be called upon to do ; and a notice under that subsection may be given with respect to one or more named persons or to persons of a class or description specified in the notice.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A notice under subsection (1) above shall name the place where the medical examination is to be conducted and, if it is a place other than the factory, the day on which and the time at which it is to be begun ; and—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>every person to whom the notice relates shall be informed, as soon as practicable after service thereof, of the contents thereof and of the fact that he is free to attend for the purpose of submitting to the examination ; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>if the notice states that the examination is to be conducted at the factory, suitable accomodation therat shall be provided for the conduct of the examination.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A medical examination conducted in pursuance of a notice under subsection (1) above shall be begun within seven days after the day on which the notice is served, and shall be conducted by, or in accordance with arrangements made by, an employment medical adviser, and take place at a reasonable time during working hours.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>An employment medical adviser may, by written notice served on the occupier of a factory, cancel a notice served on the occupier under subsection (1) above ; and a notice which relates to two or more named persons may be cancelled either in relation to them all or in relation to any one or more of them.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this section “ medical examination” includes pathological, physiological and radiological tests and similar investigations.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></BlockAmendment></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Body></Primary></Legislation>

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43" NumberOfProvisions="102" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2024-10-14"><Primary><Schedules RestrictStartDate="2021-07-16"><Title> SCHEDULES</Title><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3" NumberOfProvisions="9" id="schedule-3"><Number>SCHEDULE 3</Number><TitleBlock><Title> Amendments of Part I of the Health and Safety at Work <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation> Act 1974</Title></TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/1" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Section 6 (general duties of manufacturers etc. as regard articles and substances for use at work) shall be amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/2" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For subsection (1)

					(general duties of designers, manufacturers, importers and suppliers of articles for use at work) there shall be substituted the following subsections—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of any person who designs, manufactures, imports or supplies any article for use at work or any article of fairground equipment—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the article is so designed and constructed that it will be safe and without risks to health at all times when it is being set, used, cleaned or maintained by a person at work;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to carry out or arrange for the carrying out of such testing and examination as may be necessary for the performance of the duty imposed on him by the preceding paragraph;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure that persons supplied by that person with the article are provided with adequate information about the use for which the article is designed or has been tested and about any conditions necessary to ensure that it will be safe and without risks to health at all such times as are mentioned in paragraph (a) above and when it is being dismantled or disposed of; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that persons so supplied are provided with all such revisions of information provided to them by virtue of the preceding paragraph as are necessary by reason of its becoming known that anything gives rise to a serious risk to health or safety.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of any person who designs, manufactures, imports or supplies any article of fairground equipment—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the article is so designed and constructed that it will be safe and without risks to health at all times when it is being used for or in connection with the entertainment of members of the public;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to carry out or arrange for the carrying out of such testing and examination as may be necessary for the performance of the duty imposed on him by the preceding paragraph;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure that persons supplied by that person with the article are provided with adequate information about the use for which the article is designed or has been tested and about any conditions necessary to ensure that it will be safe and without risks to health at all times when it is being used for or in connection with the entertainment of members of the public; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that persons so supplied are provided with all such revisions of information provided to them by virtue of the preceding paragraph as are necessary by reason of its becoming known that anything gives rise to a serious risk to health or safety.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/3" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (2)

					(duty of person who undertakes the design or manufacture of an article for use at work to carry out research), after the word 

						“work” there shall be inserted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                  

						“or of any article of fairground equipment
                ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (3)

					(duty of persons who erect or install articles for use at work)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4/a" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-4-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after the words 

								“persons at work” there shall be inserted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“or who erects or installs any article of fairground equipment
                    ”</InlineAmendment>; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4/b" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-4-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words from 

								“it is” onwards there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“the article is erected or installed makes it unsafe or a risk to health at any such time as is mentioned in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) or, as the case may be, in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) or (1A) above.
                    ”</InlineAmendment></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/5" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For subsection (4)

					(general duties of manufacturers, importers and suppliers of substances for use at work) there shall be substituted the following subsection—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of any person who manufactures, imports or supplies any substance—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the substance will be safe and without risks to health at all times when it is being used, handled, processed, stored or transported by a person at work or in premises to which section 4 above applies;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to carry out or arrange for the carrying out of such testing and examination as may be necessary for the performance of the duty imposed on him by the preceding paragraph;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure that persons supplied by that person with the substance are provided with adequate information about any risks to health or safety to which the inherent properties of the substance may give rise, about the results of any relevant tests which have been carried out on or in connection with the substance and about any conditions necessary to ensure that the substance will be safe and without risks to health at all such times as are mentioned in paragraph (a) above and when the substance is being disposed of; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that persons so supplied are provided with all such revisions of information provided to them by virtue of the preceding paragraph as are necessary by reason of its becoming known that anything gives rise to a serious risk to health or safety.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (5)

					(duty of person who undertakes the manufacture of a substance for use at work to carry out research)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6/a" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-6-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words 

								“substance for use at work” there shall be substituted the word <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“substance
                    ”</InlineAmendment>; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6/b" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-6-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>at the end there shall be inserted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“at all such times as are mentioned in paragraph (a) of subsection (4) above
                    ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (8)

					(relief from duties for persons relying on undertakings by others)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/a" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-7-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words 

								“for or to another” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“for use at work or an article of fairground equipment and does so for or to another
                    ”</InlineAmendment>;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/b" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-7-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words 

								“when properly used” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“at all such times as are mentioned in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) or, as the case may be, in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) or (1A) above
                    ”</InlineAmendment>; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/c" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-7-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words 

								“by subsection (1)(a) above” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“by virtue of that paragraph
                    ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/8" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-8"><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After the said subsection (8) there shall be inserted the following subsection—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>8A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Nothing in subsection (7) or (8) above shall relieve any person who imports any article or substance from any duty in respect of anything which—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in the case of an article designed outside the United Kingdom, was done by and in the course of any trade, profession or other undertaking carried on by, or was within the control of, the person who designed the article; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in the case of an article or substance manufactured outside the United Kingdom, was done by and in the course of any trade, profession or other undertaking carried on by, or was within the control of, the person who manufactured the article or substance.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/9" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-9"><Pnumber>9</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (9)

					(definition of supplier in certain cases of supply under a hire-purchase agreement), for the words 

						“article for use at work or substance for use at work” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                  

						“article or substance
                ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/10" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/10" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-10"><Pnumber>10</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For subsection (10)

					(meaning of 

						“properly used”) there shall be substituted the following subsection—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>10</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For the purposes of this section an absence of safety or a risk to health shall be disregarded in so far as the case in or in relation to which it would arise is shown to be one the occurrence of which could not reasonably be foreseen; and in determining whether any duty imposed by virtue of paragraph (a) of subsection (1), (1A) or (4) above has been performed regard shall be had to any relevant information or advice which has been provided to any person by the person by whom the article has been designed, manufactured, imported or supplied or, as the case may be, by the person by whom the substance has been manufactured, imported or supplied.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/43/enacted" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/43" NumberOfProvisions="402" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Primary xmlns:leg="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation"><Schedules><Title>SCHEDULES</Title><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15/enacted" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15" NumberOfProvisions="35" NumberFormat="default" id="schedule-15"><Number>SCHEDULE 15</Number><TitleBlock>
<Title>Consequential and Minor Amendments of Enactments</Title>
</TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15/crossheading/workplace-emissions-into-the-air/enacted" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15/crossheading/workplace-emissions-into-the-air" NumberOfProvisions="1" id="schedule-15-crossheading-workplace-emissions-into-the-air"><Title>Workplace emissions into the air</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15/paragraph/14/enacted" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15/paragraph/14" id="schedule-15-paragraph-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 5 of the <MarginNoteRef Ref="m00160"/>Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 (general duty in relation to harmful emissions into the air from prescribed premises) shall be amended by the insertion—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15/paragraph/14/a/enacted" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15/paragraph/14/a" id="schedule-15-paragraph-14-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (1), at the beginning, of the words “Subject to subsection (5) below,”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15/paragraph/14/b/enacted" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/43/schedule/15/paragraph/14/b" id="schedule-15-paragraph-14-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after subsection (4), of the following subsections—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" TargetClass="primary" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The foregoing provisions of this section shall not apply in relation to any process which is a prescribed process as from the date which is the determination date for that process.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of subsection (6) above, the “determination date” for a prescribed process is—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a process for which an authorisation is granted, the date on which the enforcing authority grants it, whether in pursuance of the application or, on an appeal, of a direction to grant it;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a process for which an authorisation is refused, the date of the refusal or, on an appeal, of the affirmation of the refusal.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsections (5) and (6) above “authorisation”, “enforcing authority” and “prescribed process” have the meaning given in section 1 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 and the reference to an appeal is a reference to an appeal under section 15 of that Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="1994-10-01" RestrictEndDate="1996-01-01" Match="false"><Title> Extension of rights of Fund by subrogation.</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/7" id="section-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/7/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/7/1" id="section-7-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In section 8 of the <CommentaryRef Ref="c8340891"/>Merchant Shipping Act 1974 (Acquisition by International Fund of rights of recipients of payments made by the Fund in cases of oil pollution damage)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/7/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/7/1/a" id="section-7-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for subsection (1), there shall be inserted the following subsection—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text> In respect of any sum paid by the Fund as compensation for pollution damage the Fund shall acquire by subrogation any rights in respect of the damage which the recipient has (or but for the payment would have) against any other person,</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/7/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/7/1/b" id="section-7-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>subsection (3) shall be omitted.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/7/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/7/2" id="section-7-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The amendments made by subsection (1) above apply in relation to payments made by the Fund after this section comes into force.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Body></Primary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="1995-01-01" RestrictEndDate="1996-01-01" ConfersPower="true" Match="false"><Title> Power to implement 1990 OPRC Convention.</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/2" id="section-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/2/1" id="section-2-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Section 20 of the <CommentaryRef Ref="c8340791"/>Merchant Shipping Act 1979 (power by Order in Council to implement international conventions relating to pollution from ships, <Abbreviation Expansion="Et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc</Abbreviation>) shall have effect with the insertion in subsection (1), after paragraph (c), of the following paragraph—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P3><Pnumber>cc</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the International Convention on Oil Pollution Preparedness, Response and Co-operation, 1990 (including the Final Act of the Conference and the attached resolutions) signed in London on 30th November 1990;</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/2/2" id="section-2-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In consequence of the amendment made by subsection (1) above, in subsection (6) of that section for the words “(a) to (c)” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
              (a) to (cc)
            ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Body></Primary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="1995-01-01" RestrictEndDate="1996-01-01" Match="false"><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/crossheading/marine-pollution" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/crossheading/marine-pollution" NumberOfProvisions="8" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." id="crossheading-marine-pollution" RestrictStartDate="1995-01-01" RestrictEndDate="1996-01-01" Match="false"><Title> Marine Pollution</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="1994-07-28" RestrictEndDate="1996-01-01" Match="false"><Title> Amendments as to powers of implementation.</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/3" id="section-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/3/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/3/1" id="section-3-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Section 20 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1979 (power by Order in Council to implement international conventions relating to pollution from ships, etc) shall be amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/3/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/3/2" id="section-3-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (3)(a), in the list of enactments there specified, after the entry for the <CommentaryRef Ref="c8340801"/>Merchant Shipping Act 1970, there shall be inserted the following entry— <InlineAmendment>“
              section 33 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1988 (which relates to investigations of marine accidents);
            ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/3/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/3/3" id="section-3-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (4), after paragraph (a), there shall be inserted the following paragraph—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P3><Pnumber>aa</Pnumber><P3para><Text>make provision in terms of any document which the Secretary of State or any person considers relevant from time to time;</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/28/section/3/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/28/section/3/4" id="section-3-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After subsection (4), there shall be inserted the following subsections—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>4A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where an Order in Council under subsection (1) of this section authorises the making of regulations for the purpose of giving effect to an agreement mentioned in paragraphs (a) to (cc) or falling within paragraph (d) of that subsection the Order also authorises the making of regulations for the purpose of giving effect to an agreement which provides for the modification of such an agreement.</Text></P2para><P2para><Text>This subsection applies in relation to Orders in Council and international agreements whenever made.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4B</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Regulations made by virtue of paragraph (e) of subsection (4) of this section—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>may make provision corresponding to the provision authorised for an Order by paragraphs (a) to (d) of subsection (4) of this section; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>shall be subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Body></Primary></Legislation>
