<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056" NumberOfProvisions="165" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/body" NumberOfProvisions="37" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Citation, commencement, interpretation and extent</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/1" id="regulation-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations may be cited as the Waste Management Licensing Regulations 1994 and, except for regulations 4 and 5, shall come into force on 1st May 1994.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/2" id="regulation-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulations 4 and 5 shall come into force on 10th August 1994.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/3" id="regulation-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Environmental Protection Act 1990 c. 43">1990 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Environmental Protection Act 1990;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Environmental Protection (Prescribed Processes and Substances) Regulations 1991 (S.I. 1991/472)">1991 Regulations</Abbreviation>” means the Environmental Protection (Prescribed Processes and Substances) Regulations 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“construction work” includes the repair, alteration or improvement of existing works;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Council Directive 75/442/EEC on waste as amended by Council Directives 91/156/EEC and 91/692/EEC">the Directive</Abbreviation>” means Council Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1975/0442" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1975" Number="442">75/442/<Acronym Expansion="European Economic Community">EEC</Acronym></Citation> on waste<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> as amended by Council Directives <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1991/0156" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1991" Number="156">91/156/EEC</Citation><FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> and <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1991/0692" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1991" Number="692">91/692/EEC</Citation><FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Directive waste” means any substance or object in the categories set out in Part II of Schedule 4 which the producer or the person in possession of it discards or intends or is required to discard but with the exception of anything excluded from the scope of the Directive by Article 2 of the Directive, “discard” has the same meaning as in the Directive, and “producer” means anyone whose activities produce Directive waste or who carries out preprocessing, mixing or other operations resulting in a change in its nature or composition;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“disposal” means any of the operations listed in Part III of Schedule 4, and anyreference to waste being disposed of is a reference to its being submitted to any ofthose operations;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“disposal licence” and “disposal authority” have the meaning given by sections 3(1)and 30(2) to (2D) respectively of the Control of Pollution Act 1974<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“enforcing authority” and “local enforcing authority” have the meaning given bysection 1(7) and (8) of the 1990 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“exempt activity” means any of the activities set out in Schedule 3;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“inland waters”—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in England and Wales, has the meaning given by section 221(1) of the Water Resources Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in Scotland, has the meaning given by section 30A of the Control of Pollution Act 1974<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> except that it includes any loch or pond whether or not it discharges into a river or watercourse;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“operational land” has the meaning given by sections 263 and 264 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/> or, in Scotland, sections 211 and 212 of the Town and Country Planning (Scotland) Act 1972<FootnoteRef Ref="f00015"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“recovery” means any of the operations listed in Part IV of Schedule 4, and any reference to waste being recovered is a reference to its being submitted to any of those operations;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“scrap metal” has the meaning given by section 9(2) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 1964<FootnoteRef Ref="f00016"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“special waste” has the meaning given by regulation 2 of the Control of Pollution (Special Waste) Regulations 1980<FootnoteRef Ref="f00017"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“waste” means Directive waste;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“waste management licence” has the meaning given by section 35(1) of the 1990 Act,and “site licence” has the meaning given by section 35(12) of the 1990 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“waste oil” means any mineral-based lubricating or industrial oil which has become unfit for the use for which it was originally intended and, in particular, used combustion engine oil, gearbox oil, mineral lubricating oil, oil for turbines and hydraulic oil;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“waste regulation authority”, “waste disposal authority” and “waste collection authority” have the meaning given by section 30 of the 1990 Act; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“work” includes preparatory work.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/4" id="regulation-1-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any reference in these Regulations to carrying on business as a scrap metal dealer has the meaning given by section 9(1) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 1964, and any reference, in relation to Scotland, to carrying on business as a metal dealer has the meaning given by section 37(2) of the Civic Government (Scotland) Act 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00018"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5" id="regulation-1-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulations 13, 14 and 15, and Schedule 4, shall apply in relation to land in the area of a waste disposal authority in Scotland which is occupied by the authority as if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/a" id="regulation-1-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to a waste management licence were references to a resolution undersection 54 of the 1990 Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/b" id="regulation-1-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to an application being made for a waste management licence were references to consideration being given to passing such a resolution;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/c" id="regulation-1-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to granting or issuing a waste management licence were references to passing, and references to rejecting an application were references to not passing, such a resolution;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/d" id="regulation-1-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to the terms or conditions of a waste management licence were references to the terms or conditions specified in such a resolution; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/e" id="regulation-1-5-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to varying or revoking a waste management licence under section 37 or 38 of the 1990 Act were references to varying or rescinding such a resolution under section 54(8) of that Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/6" id="regulation-1-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations do not extend to Northern Ireland.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/541/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/541" NumberOfProvisions="18" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/541/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/541/body" NumberOfProvisions="18" NumberFormat="default"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/541/regulation/16/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/541/regulation/16" id="regulation-16">

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592" NumberOfProvisions="110" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Schedules><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9" NumberOfProvisions="11" NumberFormat="default" id="schedule-9"><Number>SCHEDULE 9</Number><TitleBlock>
<Title>MODIFICATIONS</Title>
</TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/part/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/part/2" NumberOfProvisions="1" id="schedule-9-part-2"><Title>The Factories Act 1961</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Factories Act 1961<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> is modified as follows—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/a" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 127, sub-section (3) shall cease to have effect;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 176, in sub-section (1)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/i" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “building operation” shall be deleted and the following substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P4para>
<Text>“building operation” and “work of engineering construction” mean “construction work” within the meaning assigned to that phrase by regulation 2(1) of the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 1994 (<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/3140" id="c00001" Class="UnitedKingdomStatutoryInstrument" Year="1994" Number="3140">S.I. 1994/3140</Citation>);</Text>
</P4para></BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/ii" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “work of engineering construction” is deleted.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Part></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="2023-08-17"><Number>PART I</Number><Title>MODIFICATIONS OF ACTS OF PARLIAMENT</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="1999-07-01"><Title>Environment Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1995/25" id="c00141" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1995" Number="0025">1995 (c. 25)</Citation></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-6d7a90"/>120</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/1" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Environment Act 1995 is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 31 (guidance on sustainable development and other aims and objectives)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/a" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsections (5), (6) and (7), for “each House of Parliament”, “either House” and “Parliament”, as the case may be, there is substituted “the Scottish Parliament”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/b" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (5) “or, if the draft is laid on different days, the later of the two days.” is omitted; and</Text>

<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “appropriate load lines”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/i" id="regulation-3-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for ““appropriate load lines” means the load lines” there shall be substituted ““appropriate load line” means the load line”, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/ii" id="regulation-3-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>before “an International” there shall be inserted “an International Load Line Certificate or”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “appropriate certificate”, for “International Load Certificate 1966,” there shall be substituted “International Load Line Certificate or an International Load Line Certificate (1966),”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Category A, B, C or D waters”, for “<Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> M. 1504” there shall be substituted “<Acronym Expansion="Merchant Shipping Notice">MSN</Acronym> 1719 (M)”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definition of “column stabilised” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “Convention country” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“conditions of assignment” means the conditions relating to construction, arrangement and stability with which a ship must comply in order to be assigned freeboards;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Convention country”, for sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) there shall be substituted–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a country the Government of which is party to the 1966 Convention, or to the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a territory to which the 1966 Convention, or the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol, extends;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/i" id="regulation-3-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “exclusive surveyor” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Exemption Certificate” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate or a United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j" id="regulation-3-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “freeboard deck”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/i" id="regulation-3-j-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b) for “.” there shall be substituted “ ,”, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/ii" id="regulation-3-j-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for the paragraph beginning “When this lower deck is stepped” there shall be substituted, indented in line with the full-out part of the definition—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>a deck which is stepped being taken to consist for this purpose of the lowest line of the deck and the continuation of that line parallel to the upper part of the deck;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/k/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/k" id="regulation-3-k">
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “freeboard deck” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Certificate” means an International Load Line Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Certificate (1966)” means an International Load Line Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention before the relevant entry into force date (if any);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Exemption Certificate” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Exemption Certificate (1966)” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention before the relevant entry into force date (if any);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/l/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/l" id="regulation-3-l">
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “length” and “(L)” there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“length” and “(L)” in relation to a ship means the greater of the following distances—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>96% of the total length on a waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth measured from the top of the keel, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the length from the fore-side of the stem to the axis of the rudder stock on that waterline.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Where the stem contour is concave above the waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth, both the forward terminal of the total length and the fore-side of the stem respectively shall be taken at the vertical projection to that waterline of the aftermost point of the stem contour (above that waterline). In ships designed with a rake of keel the waterline on which this length is measured shall be parallel to the designed waterline;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m" id="regulation-3-m">
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definitions of “mobile offshore drilling unit” and “mobile offshore support unit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n" id="regulation-3-n">
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “rake of keel” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant entry into force date” means the date when the 1988 Protocol enters into force in respect of the Government of the parent country of the ship in question;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o" id="regulation-3-o">
<Pnumber>o</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “surveyor” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 9(1) other than an International Load Line Certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 12(2);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p" id="regulation-3-p">
<Pnumber>p</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “valid Convention certificate” there shall be substituted:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“valid Convention certificate” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate (1966) or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate (1966), which is in force, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate, which is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 4(1)(e), for “80 tons register” there shall be substituted “ 80 net tons”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 4(2), sub-paragraph (e) shall be omitted.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 6(5), for “(i) an appropriate certificate;” to the end of paragraph (5) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a Convention-size ship, a valid Convention certificate, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of any other ship, a United Kingdom Load Line Certificate or a United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate, which is in force in relation to the ship.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the heading to regulation 8, for “Initial, periodical and annual surveys” there shall be substituted “Initial, renewal and annual surveys ”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/8" id="regulation-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 8(1)(b), after “years” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1para>
<Text>(except where paragraph (2)(a), (5), (6) or (7) of regulation 10 is applicable)</Text>
</P1para>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/9" id="regulation-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 8(1)(c) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>An annual survey within the period of three months before or after each anniversary date of the appropriate certificate to ensure that—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>alterations have not been made to the hull or superstructures which would affect the calculations determining the position of the load line;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the fittings and appliances for the protection of openings, guard rails, freeing ports and means of access to crew’s quarters are maintained in an effective condition;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the appropriate marks are correctly and permanently indicated; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>information is provided in accordance with regulations 32 and 33.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/10" id="regulation-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 8(3), before “the International” there shall be inserted “ the International Load Line Certificate,”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/11" id="regulation-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(1), for “the appropriate certificate” there shall be substituted “an International Load Line Certificate in the case of a Convention-size ship, or a United Kingdom Load Line Certificate in the case of any other ship,”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/12" id="regulation-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 9(2) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If the certificate is an International Load Line Certificate it shall be in the form prescribed by Annex <Acronym Expansion="3">III</Acronym> to the 1988 Protocol.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/13" id="regulation-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(3), for “MSN 1701 (M)” there shall be substituted “ MSN 1752 (M)”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/14" id="regulation-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(5), for “to issue or authorise the issue” to the end of the paragraph there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to issue or authorise the issue of, in respect of the ship, an International Load Line Certificate, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of an annual survey required under regulation 8(1)(c), to endorse or authorise the endorsement of the International Load Line Certificate, the International Load Line Certificate (1966) or, as the case may be, the United Kingdom Load Line Certificate accordingly;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and a certificate issued or an endorsement made in accordance with such a request, and containing a statement that it has been so issued or made, shall have the same effect as if it had been issued by the Secretary of State or made by a surveyor respectively.</Text>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15" id="regulation-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(6)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/a" id="regulation-15-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“(1966)” shall be omitted, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/b" id="regulation-15-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (a) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the ship has already been subjected to satisfactory initial, renewal and annual surveys, as appropriate;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335" NumberOfProvisions="48" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/body" NumberOfProvisions="45" NumberFormat="default"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Merchant Shipping (Load Line) Regulations 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall be amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “the 1966 Convention” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="the Protocol of 1988 relating to the 1966 Convention (Cmnd. 4419)">1988 Protocol</Abbreviation>” means the Protocol of 1988 relating to the 1966 Convention<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “amidships” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“anniversary date” in relation to a certificate means the day and the month of each year which corresponds to the date of expiry of the certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “appropriate load lines”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/i" id="regulation-3-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for ““appropriate load lines” means the load lines” there shall be substituted ““appropriate load line” means the load line”, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/ii" id="regulation-3-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>before “an International” there shall be inserted “an International Load Line Certificate or”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “appropriate certificate”, for “International Load Certificate 1966,” there shall be substituted “International Load Line Certificate or an International Load Line Certificate (1966),”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Category A, B, C or D waters”, for “<Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> M. 1504” there shall be substituted “<Acronym Expansion="Merchant Shipping Notice">MSN</Acronym> 1719 (M)”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definition of “column stabilised” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “Convention country” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“conditions of assignment” means the conditions relating to construction, arrangement and stability with which a ship must comply in order to be assigned freeboards;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Convention country”, for sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) there shall be substituted–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a country the Government of which is party to the 1966 Convention, or to the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a territory to which the 1966 Convention, or the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol, extends;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/i" id="regulation-3-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “exclusive surveyor” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Exemption Certificate” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate or a United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j" id="regulation-3-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “freeboard deck”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/i" id="regulation-3-j-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b) for “.” there shall be substituted “ ,”, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/ii" id="regulation-3-j-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for the paragraph beginning “When this lower deck is stepped” there shall be substituted, indented in line with the full-out part of the definition—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>a deck which is stepped being taken to consist for this purpose of the lowest line of the deck and the continuation of that line parallel to the upper part of the deck;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/k/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/k" id="regulation-3-k">
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “freeboard deck” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Certificate” means an International Load Line Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Certificate (1966)” means an International Load Line Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention before the relevant entry into force date (if any);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Exemption Certificate” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Exemption Certificate (1966)” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention before the relevant entry into force date (if any);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/l/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/l" id="regulation-3-l">
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “length” and “(L)” there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“length” and “(L)” in relation to a ship means the greater of the following distances—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>96% of the total length on a waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth measured from the top of the keel, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the length from the fore-side of the stem to the axis of the rudder stock on that waterline.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Where the stem contour is concave above the waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth, both the forward terminal of the total length and the fore-side of the stem respectively shall be taken at the vertical projection to that waterline of the aftermost point of the stem contour (above that waterline). In ships designed with a rake of keel the waterline on which this length is measured shall be parallel to the designed waterline;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m" id="regulation-3-m">
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definitions of “mobile offshore drilling unit” and “mobile offshore support unit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n" id="regulation-3-n">
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “rake of keel” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant entry into force date” means the date when the 1988 Protocol enters into force in respect of the Government of the parent country of the ship in question;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o" id="regulation-3-o">
<Pnumber>o</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “surveyor” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 9(1) other than an International Load Line Certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 12(2);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p" id="regulation-3-p">
<Pnumber>p</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “valid Convention certificate” there shall be substituted:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“valid Convention certificate” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate (1966) or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate (1966), which is in force, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate, which is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 4(1)(e), for “80 tons register” there shall be substituted “ 80 net tons”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 4(2), sub-paragraph (e) shall be omitted.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 6(5), for “(i) an appropriate certificate;” to the end of paragraph (5) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a Convention-size ship, a valid Convention certificate, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of any other ship, a United Kingdom Load Line Certificate or a United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate, which is in force in relation to the ship.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the heading to regulation 8, for “Initial, periodical and annual surveys” there shall be substituted “Initial, renewal and annual surveys ”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/8" id="regulation-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 8(1)(b), after “years” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1para>
<Text>(except where paragraph (2)(a), (5), (6) or (7) of regulation 10 is applicable)</Text>
</P1para>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/9" id="regulation-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 8(1)(c) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>An annual survey within the period of three months before or after each anniversary date of the appropriate certificate to ensure that—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>alterations have not been made to the hull or superstructures which would affect the calculations determining the position of the load line;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the fittings and appliances for the protection of openings, guard rails, freeing ports and means of access to crew’s quarters are maintained in an effective condition;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the appropriate marks are correctly and permanently indicated; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>information is provided in accordance with regulations 32 and 33.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/10" id="regulation-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 8(3), before “the International” there shall be inserted “ the International Load Line Certificate,”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/11" id="regulation-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(1), for “the appropriate certificate” there shall be substituted “an International Load Line Certificate in the case of a Convention-size ship, or a United Kingdom Load Line Certificate in the case of any other ship,”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/12" id="regulation-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 9(2) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If the certificate is an International Load Line Certificate it shall be in the form prescribed by Annex <Acronym Expansion="3">III</Acronym> to the 1988 Protocol.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/13" id="regulation-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(3), for “MSN 1701 (M)” there shall be substituted “ MSN 1752 (M)”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/14" id="regulation-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(5), for “to issue or authorise the issue” to the end of the paragraph there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to issue or authorise the issue of, in respect of the ship, an International Load Line Certificate, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of an annual survey required under regulation 8(1)(c), to endorse or authorise the endorsement of the International Load Line Certificate, the International Load Line Certificate (1966) or, as the case may be, the United Kingdom Load Line Certificate accordingly;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and a certificate issued or an endorsement made in accordance with such a request, and containing a statement that it has been so issued or made, shall have the same effect as if it had been issued by the Secretary of State or made by a surveyor respectively.</Text>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15" id="regulation-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(6)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/a" id="regulation-15-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“(1966)” shall be omitted, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/b" id="regulation-15-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (a) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the ship has already been subjected to satisfactory initial, renewal and annual surveys, as appropriate;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/16/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/16" id="regulation-16">
<Pnumber>16</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 10 there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2), (4), (5) and (6), the duration of any certificate issued under these Regulations shall not exceed a period of five years beginning with the date of completion of the initial or renewal survey referred to in regulation 8(1)(a) or (b) respectively.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>When the renewal survey referred to in regulation 8(1)(b) is completed within three months before the expiry of the existing certificate, the new certificate shall be valid for a period beginning with the date of completion of the renewal survey and ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the expiry of the existing certificate.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>When the renewal survey referred to in regulation 8(1)(b) is completed after the expiry of the existing certificate, the new certificate shall be valid for a period beginning with the date of completion of the renewal survey and ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the expiry of the previous certificate.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>When the renewal survey referred to in regulation 8(1)(b) is completed more than three months before the expiry of the existing certificate, the new certificate shall be valid for a period beginning with the date of completion of the renewal survey and ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the date of completion of the renewal survey.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If a certificate is issued for a period of less than five years, the Assigning Authority may extend the validity of the certificate beyond the expiry date to the maximum period specified in paragraph (1), provided that the annual surveys applicable when a certificate is issued for a period of five years are carried out as appropriate.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If, after the renewal survey, a new certificate cannot be issued to the ship before the expiry of the existing certificate, the Assigning Authority may extend the validity of the existing certificate for a period which shall not exceed five months. This extension shall be endorsed on the certificate, and shall be granted only where there have been no alterations in the structure, equipment, arrangements, materials or scantlings which affect the ship’s freeboard.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If, at the time when a certificate expires, a ship is not in a port in which it is to be surveyed, the Assigning Authority may extend the validity of the certificate but this extension shall be granted only where it appears proper and reasonable to the Assigning Authority to do so for the purpose of allowing the ship to complete its voyage to the port in which it is to be surveyed. No certificate shall be extended for a period longer than three months beginning with the date of expiry, and a ship to which an extension is granted shall not, on its arrival in the port in which it is to be surveyed, be entitled by virtue of such extension to leave that port without having a new certificate. When the renewal survey is completed, the new certificate shall be valid for a period ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the expiry of the previous certificate before the extension was granted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A certificate issued to a ship engaged on short voyages which has not been extended under paragraph (3), (4) or (5) of this regulation may be extended by the Assigning Authority for a period of not more than one month beginning with the date of its expiry. When the renewal survey is completed the new certificate shall be valid for a period ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the expiry of the previous certificate before the extension was granted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In special circumstances, as determined by the Assigning Authority, a new certificate need not be dated from the expiry of the previous certificate before the extension was granted, as required by paragraphs (2), (5) and (6). In these special circumstances, the new certificate shall be valid for a period ending on a date which is not more than five years from the date of completion of the renewal survey.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If an annual survey is completed before the period specified in regulation 8(1)(c) then:</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a new anniversary date shall be endorsed on the certificate which shall not be more than three months later than the date on which the annual survey was completed;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the subsequent annual survey required by regulation 8(1)(c) shall be completed at the intervals prescribed by that regulation using the new anniversary date;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the expiry date of the certificate may remain unchanged provided one or more annual surveys are carried out so that the maximum intervals between the surveys prescribed by regulation 8(1)(c) are not exceeded.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/17/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/17" id="regulation-17">
<Pnumber>17</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 11 there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Certificates ceasing to be valid, and surrender and cancellation of certificates</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An appropriate certificate issued in respect of a United Kingdom ship shall cease to be valid where—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>material alterations have taken place in the hull or superstructures of the ship such as would necessitate the assignment of an increased freeboard;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the fittings and appliances mentioned in regulation 8(1)(c)(ii) are not maintained in an effective condition;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the certificate is not endorsed in accordance with regulation 8(3) to show the ship has been surveyed in accordance with regulation 8(1)(c);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the structural strength of the ship is lowered to such an extent that the ship is unsafe;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a new certificate is issued in respect of the ship; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the ship ceases to be a United Kingdom ship.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Secretary of State may cancel an appropriate certificate issued in respect of a United Kingdom ship if he is satisfied that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the certificate was issued on false or erroneous information;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>information on the basis of which freeboards were assigned to the ship was incorrect in a material particular; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the ship ceases to comply with the conditions of assignment relating to it.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the Secretary of State proposes to cancel a certificate, he shall first notify the owner in writing, specifying the grounds for the proposed cancellation.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (5), the Secretary of State shall not cancel the certificate until the owner has been given a reasonable opportunity to make representations, and the Secretary of State has considered any such representations made.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (4) shall not apply where the Secretary of State considers that urgent safety considerations so require.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Secretary of State may require any certificate issued under these Regulations which has expired, ceased to be valid, or been cancelled, to be surrendered as he directs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The requirement that the notification referred to in paragraph (3) should be in writing is satisfied where the text of the notification—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is transmitted by electronic means,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is received in legible form, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is capable of being used for subsequent reference.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/18/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/18" id="regulation-18">
<Pnumber>18</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 12(1) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a ship is exempted under regulation 5(1) or (3), an International Load Line Exemption Certificate in the form prescribed by the 1966 Convention as amended by Annex III to the 1988 Protocol shall be issued in respect of the ship by the Secretary of State.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19" id="regulation-19">
<Pnumber>19</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 12(2)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/a" id="regulation-19-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the quotation marks around “United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate ” shall be omitted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/b" id="regulation-19-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end there shall be added—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>, and which shall be in the form prescribed in Schedule 8 of Merchant Shipping Notice MSN 1752 (M).</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/20/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/20" id="regulation-20">
<Pnumber>20</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 12(3), for paragraph (c) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulations 8 to 11 shall apply in relation to the Exemption Certificate as they apply in relation to an appropriate certificate,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/21/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/21" id="regulation-21">
<Pnumber>21</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 13(2), for “MSN 1701 (M)” there shall be substituted “ MSN 1752 (M)”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22" id="regulation-22">
<Pnumber>22</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 14(1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/a" id="regulation-22-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after “1966 Convention” in both places it occurs, there shall be inserted “as amended by the 1988 Protocol”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/b" id="regulation-22-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“(1966)” shall be omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335" NumberOfProvisions="48" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/body" NumberOfProvisions="45" NumberFormat="default"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Merchant Shipping (Load Line) Regulations 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall be amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “the 1966 Convention” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="the Protocol of 1988 relating to the 1966 Convention (Cmnd. 4419)">1988 Protocol</Abbreviation>” means the Protocol of 1988 relating to the 1966 Convention<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “amidships” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“anniversary date” in relation to a certificate means the day and the month of each year which corresponds to the date of expiry of the certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “appropriate load lines”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/i" id="regulation-3-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for ““appropriate load lines” means the load lines” there shall be substituted ““appropriate load line” means the load line”, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/ii" id="regulation-3-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>before “an International” there shall be inserted “an International Load Line Certificate or”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “appropriate certificate”, for “International Load Certificate 1966,” there shall be substituted “International Load Line Certificate or an International Load Line Certificate (1966),”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Category A, B, C or D waters”, for “<Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> M. 1504” there shall be substituted “<Acronym Expansion="Merchant Shipping Notice">MSN</Acronym> 1719 (M)”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definition of “column stabilised” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “Convention country” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“conditions of assignment” means the conditions relating to construction, arrangement and stability with which a ship must comply in order to be assigned freeboards;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Convention country”, for sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) there shall be substituted–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a country the Government of which is party to the 1966 Convention, or to the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a territory to which the 1966 Convention, or the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol, extends;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/i" id="regulation-3-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “exclusive surveyor” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Exemption Certificate” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate or a United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
