<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j" id="regulation-3-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “freeboard deck”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/i" id="regulation-3-j-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b) for “.” there shall be substituted “ ,”, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/ii" id="regulation-3-j-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for the paragraph beginning “When this lower deck is stepped” there shall be substituted, indented in line with the full-out part of the definition—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>a deck which is stepped being taken to consist for this purpose of the lowest line of the deck and the continuation of that line parallel to the upper part of the deck;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/k/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/k" id="regulation-3-k">
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “freeboard deck” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Certificate” means an International Load Line Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Certificate (1966)” means an International Load Line Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention before the relevant entry into force date (if any);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Exemption Certificate” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Exemption Certificate (1966)” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention before the relevant entry into force date (if any);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/l/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/l" id="regulation-3-l">
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “length” and “(L)” there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“length” and “(L)” in relation to a ship means the greater of the following distances—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>96% of the total length on a waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth measured from the top of the keel, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the length from the fore-side of the stem to the axis of the rudder stock on that waterline.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Where the stem contour is concave above the waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth, both the forward terminal of the total length and the fore-side of the stem respectively shall be taken at the vertical projection to that waterline of the aftermost point of the stem contour (above that waterline). In ships designed with a rake of keel the waterline on which this length is measured shall be parallel to the designed waterline;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m" id="regulation-3-m">
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definitions of “mobile offshore drilling unit” and “mobile offshore support unit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n" id="regulation-3-n">
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “rake of keel” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant entry into force date” means the date when the 1988 Protocol enters into force in respect of the Government of the parent country of the ship in question;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o" id="regulation-3-o">
<Pnumber>o</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “surveyor” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 9(1) other than an International Load Line Certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 12(2);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p" id="regulation-3-p">
<Pnumber>p</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “valid Convention certificate” there shall be substituted:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“valid Convention certificate” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate (1966) or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate (1966), which is in force, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate, which is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174/body" NumberOfProvisions="16" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> shall be amended—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6/a" id="regulation-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1), by inserting, before the definition of “new workplace”, the following definition—</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-disabled-person">disabled person</Term>” has the meaning given by section 1 of the Disability Discrimination Act 1995;</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha" Start="2">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in the definition of “workplace” in regulation 2(1), by deleting the words “but shall not” to the end of the definition;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by inserting after regulation 4 the following regulation—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Stability and solidity</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>4A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where a workplace is in a building, the building shall have a stability and solidity appropriate to the nature of the use of the workplace.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in regulation 5(3)—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by deleting the word “and” after sub-paragraph (a);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="ii">
<Para>
<Text>by adding the word “and” after sub-paragraph (b); and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="iii">
<Para>
<Text>by adding the following sub-paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>equipment and devices intended to prevent or reduce hazards</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by deleting regulation 6(3);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in regulation 7, by inserting the following paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a workplace shall be adequately thermally insulated where it is necessary, having regard to the type of work carried out and the physical activity of the persons carrying out the work; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>excessive effects of sunlight on temperature shall be avoided.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) of regulation 24, by adding the words “and the facilities are easily accessible, of sufficient capacity and provided with seating”;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in regulation 25, by substituting for paragraph (3) the following paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Rest rooms and rest areas shall—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>include suitable arrangements to protect non-smokers from discomfort caused by tobacco smoke; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>be equipped with—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>an adequate number of tables and adequate seating with backs for the number of persons at work likely to use them at any one time; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>seating which is adequate for the number of disabled persons at work and suitable for them.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by inserting after regulation 25 the following regulation—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Disabled persons</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>25A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where necessary, those parts of the workplace (including in particular doors, passageways, stairs, showers, washbasins, lavatories and workstations) used or occupied directly by disabled persons at work shall be organised to take account of such persons.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Merchant Shipping (Passenger Ships on Domestic Voyages) Regulations

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/1107/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/1107" NumberOfProvisions="3" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/1107/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/1107/body" NumberOfProvisions="3" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Merchant Shipping (Passenger Ships on Domestic Voyages) Regulations 2000</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/1107/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/1107/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For the definition of “the Directive” in regulation 2(1) (Interpretation) of the Merchant Shipping (Passenger Ships on Domestic Voyages) Regulations 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> there shall be substituted:</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Directive” means Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0018" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="18">98/18/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation> of 17th March 1998 on Safety Rules and Standards for Passenger Ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> as amended by</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Commission Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2002/0025" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2002" Number="25">2002/25/EC</Citation> of 5th March 2002 amending Council Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0018" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="18">98/18/EC</Citation> on safety rules and standards for passenger ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2002/0084" id="c00004" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2002" Number="84">2002/84/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5th November 2002 amending the Directives on maritime safety and the prevention of pollution from ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Commission Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0075" id="c00005" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="75">2003/75/EC</Citation> of 29th July 2003 amending Annex I to Council Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0018" id="c00006" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="18">98/18/EC</Citation> on safety rules and standards for passenger ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList><Text>in so far as the references in Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0018" id="c00007" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="18">98/18/EC</Citation> as so amended to the Conventions, Codes and System in their up-to-date versions:</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>relate to all or any of the purposes set out in section 85(1) of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="ii">
<Para>
<Text>are considered by the Secretary of State to be relevant from time to time, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="iii">
<Para>
<Text>are specified in a Merchant Shipping Notice.”.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399" NumberOfProvisions="7" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Secondary xmlns:leg="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation"><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/body" NumberOfProvisions="7" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI" NumberFormat="default"><P1group RestrictStartDate="2005-06-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Interpretation</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In these Regulations “the <Abbreviation Expansion="Environmental Impact Assessment (Land Drainage Improvement Works) Regulations 1999 (S.I. 1999/1783)">1999 Regulations</Abbreviation>” means the Environmental Impact Assessment (Land Drainage Improvement Works) Regulations 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2005-06-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Public participation</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The 1999 Regulations shall be amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 5 (Requirements where a drainage body consider improvement works are not likely to have significant effects on the environment)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/a" id="regulation-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (1)(c), delete “and”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/b" id="regulation-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (1)(d), insert “; and”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/c" id="regulation-3-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (1)(d) insert —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>describe what additional information concerning the improvement works is available, and where it can be obtained.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 6 (Notification of determination that improvement works are likely to have significant effects on the environment), amend paragraph (2) as follows –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a), at the beginning insert “inform the public of the need for a determination of whether the improvement works should proceed, and”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b), insert “; and”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/c" id="regulation-3-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (b) insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>give details of the drainage body responsible for taking the decision as to whether to carry out the improvement works, from whom relevant information can be obtained and to which comments or questions can be submitted, and details of the time by which comments or questions must be submitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>give an indication of the availability of the information gathered;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>give details of times and places where, and the means by which, the relevant information will be made available.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 12 (Determination of whether improvement works should proceed)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4/a" id="regulation-3-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (7)(c)(ii) substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the main reasons and considerations upon which this determination was based, including information about the public participation process; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4/b" id="regulation-3-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (8) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to any determination made by itself or by the appropriate Authority in accordance with this regulation, the drainage body shall maintain a record of, and make available to the public on request, the following information—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the content of the decision and any conditions attached thereto;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the main reasons and considerations on which the decision is based, including information about representations received in the course of the public participation process; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a description, where necessary, of the main measures to avoid and reduce the major adverse effects.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5" id="regulation-3-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>in regulation 13 (charges), amend paragraph (1) as follows —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5/a" id="regulation-3-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a)(ii), after “regulation 12(6)(b)”, insert “or regulation 13A”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5/b" id="regulation-3-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (b)(ii), after “regulation 12(6)(c)”, insert “or regulation 13A”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/6" id="regulation-3-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 13 insert —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Public participation</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The drainage body shall make available to the public —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the time that the notice under regulation 5(1) is published, all relevant information that is relevant to the improvement works;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any further information which is relevant to the determination under regulation 12(7) above, and which only becomes available after the time that the public was given notice in accordance with regulation 5(1)(d), whether as a result of a request from the appropriate Authority under regulation 5(6) above or otherwise; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any further information which is relevant to the assessment under regulation 12(1) above, and which becomes available after the time that the public notice was published in accordance with regulation 6(2) above.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2005-06-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Public notices</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The 1999 Regulations shall be further amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 5(1) and 6(2), for “by notice in at least two local newspapers”, substitute “, subject to regulation 13B below, by notice in at least two local newspapers and on any website maintained by the drainage body”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 5(3), (4) and (5), after “paragraph (1)(d) above” insert “(or the period of 28 days referred to in regulation 13B(3)(a) below, whichever is the greater)”</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 10(3) and 12(6)(a), at the beginning insert “Subject to regulation 13B(1) below,”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/5" id="regulation-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 12(3) and 12(8), after “shall” insert “, subject to regulation 13B below,”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/6" id="regulation-4-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 13A, insert —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Notices on the site of the proposed improvement works</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the site of the proposed improvement works is easily visible from a public highway, a drainage body may, instead of placing a notice in a local paper in accordance with regulation 5(1), 6(2), 10(3), 12(3), 12(6)(a) or 12(8), post on the site a notice or notices containing, subject to paragraph (2), the information specified in the regulation in question.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In a notice posted under paragraph (1) in substitution to a notice published under regulation 5(1) or 12(6)(a), the period specified as the period within which representations may be made shall be not less than 28 days from the date on which the notice is first posted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The notice mentioned in paragraph (1) must –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>be left in position for not less than seven consecutive days in the 28 days following the date on which the notice is first posted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>be affixed firmly to some object on the site in such a way as to be easily visible to, and readable by, members of the public without going on to the land.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2005-06-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Other amendments of the 1999 Regulations</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/1" id="regulation-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The 1999 Regulations shall be further amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2" id="regulation-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2 (Interpretation) –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a" id="regulation-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “consultation bodies” —</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a/i" id="regulation-5-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph (a), after “English Nature ”, insert “, English Heritage”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a/ii" id="regulation-5-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph (b), after “Countryside Council for Wales”, insert “and Cadw, being the executive agency responsible for carrying out the functions vested in the National Assembly relating to the historic environment”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/b" id="regulation-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “the Directive”, at the end insert “and Council Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0035" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="35">2003/35/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation> on providing for public participation in respect of the drawing up of certain plans and programmes relating to the environment and amending with regard to public participation and access to justice Council Directives <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1985/0337" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1985" Number="337">85/337/<Acronym Expansion="European Economic Community">EEC</Acronym></Citation> and <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1996/0061" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1996" Number="61">96/61/EC</Citation>”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/c" id="regulation-5-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “improvement works”, after the words “or otherwise improve” (in each place where they occur) insert “or alter,”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/3" id="regulation-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3 (Restriction on improvement works), for paragraph (2) substitute —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the appropriate Authority considers, in relation to particular improvement works, that there are exceptional grounds for doing so, it may direct that the provisions of these Regulations shall not apply in relation to the works in question.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this event, the appropriate authority shall —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>consider whether another form of assessment would be appropriate;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where it carries out any other form of assessment, make available to the public the information obtained under that assessment, the reasons for its decision to give a direction under paragraph (2) and any information relied on in making that decision;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/4" id="regulation-5-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 3 (Information for other <Acronym Expansion="European Economic Area">EEA</Acronym> states), in paragraph 4, for “the following information:–”, substitute “the information required to be given under regulation 6(2),”, and delete sub-paragraphs (a), (b) and (c).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

PART 7 <SmallCaps>Records and Returns</SmallCaps><Emphasis>Producer and transport records</Emphasis>Consignee and self-disposal quarterly returns531Every consignee shall make a return, in these Regulations referred to as a consignee quarterly return, to the Agency of information relating to all consignments of hazardous waste received by him in any quarter in accordance with paragraph (4).2The return shall include—arejected consignments;bhazardous waste delivered by pipeline where regulation 41 applies; andcin the case of multiple collections, each individual consignment collected.3Where in any quarter hazardous waste is disposed of by depositing it within the curtilage of the premises at which it is produced, the producer shall make a return in respect of that quarter of information relating to the deposit to the Agency (including the consignment code), in accordance with paragraph (4).4A return to be made pursuant to this regulation in respect of a quarter shall be made no later than the time specified in the right hand column of the table below in relation to the quarter specified in the left hand column:
Quarter in which the hazardous waste was received, or deposited, as the case may beReturn to be received by the Agency not later than
Ending on 31st March30st April in the same year as the quarter falls
Ending on 30th June31st July in the same year as the quarter falls
Ending on 30th September31st October in the same year as the quarter falls
Ending on 31st December31st January in the year next following the year in which the quarter falls
5The Agency may prescribe a format for returns to be made under this regulation and, where for the time being a format is prescribed pursuant to this paragraph—athe Agency shall publish the format on its website and in such other manner as it may consider appropriate for informing persons required to submit such returns of its content; andbthe Agency shall not be obliged to consider a return as properly made for the purposes of these Regulations unless it is made in that format, or in a format substantially to like effect.6If the Agency prescribe a fee payable by a consignee by charging scheme made under section 41 of the Environment Act 1995 as a means of recovering its costs incurred in performing functions in relation to the consignments included on the consignee quarterly returns, a consignee may recover from a consignor any fees paid under these Regulations in relation to consignments sent by that consignor.Consignee's return to the producer, holder or consignor541Without prejudice to any duty under these Regulations on the part of the consignee to send any document or copy thereof to the producer, holder or consignor, a consignee shall send to a producer or holder identified in the relevant part of a consignment note—aa return in a form corresponding to that set out in Schedule 8 or a form substantially to like effect within one month of the end of the quarter in which the waste concerned was accepted; orba copy of the consignment note together with a description of the method of disposal or recovery undertaken in relation to the waste, within one month of the end of the quarter in which the waste concerned was accepted.2Where hazardous waste was delivered by pipeline in a case to which regulation 41 applies, paragraph (1) shall apply so that the return required under sub-paragraph (a) or the information required under sub-paragraph (b) shall be supplied within one month of the end of the quarter in which the waste concerned was piped.3Where regulation 42 applies, this regulation does not apply to the consignment or part concerned.Duties to supply information551A person who is required to retain any record pursuant to any of the foregoing provisions of this Part shall, at any time during the period in which the record is required to be retained produce that record to the Agency or emergency services on request.2A producer holder, previous holder, consignor, carrier or consignee of hazardous waste shall supply to the Agency on request such information as it may reasonably require for the purposes of performing its functions in connection with these Regulations and for the purposes of monitoring the production, movement, storage, treatment, recovery and disposal of hazardous waste.3An establishment or undertaking to which hazardous waste is delivered for recovery or disposal, as the case may be, has the duty to supply to the Agency on request documentary evidence that the disposal or recovery operation concerned has been carried out, indicating where applicable, the relevant entry listed in Annex I or Annex II, as the case may be, of the Waste Directive.4A person who is required to supply information to the Agency pursuant to this regulation shall supply that information in such form as the Agency may reasonably request.5The power conferred by paragraph (4) includes power to require the production in a visible and legible documentary form of any information is held in electronic form.6Any request for information under this regulation shall be in writing and shall specify the period within which the information is to be supplied. PART 8 <SmallCaps>THE AGENCY'S FUNCTIONS</SmallCaps>Inspections of hazardous waste producers56It is the duty of the Agency to carry out appropriate periodic inspections of hazardous waste producers.Inspections of collection and transport operations57. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .Agency to retain registers etc58The Agency shall retain registers and any accompanying records sent to it pursuant to regulation 51(3) for a period of not less than three years commencing with the receipt thereof by the Agency.Fees591Section 41 of the 1995 Act (power to make schemes imposing charges) is amended as follows.2For subsection (1)(c) substitute—cas a means of recovering costs incurred by it in performing functions conferred by regulations made for the purpose of implementing Council Directive 91/689/EEC the Agency may require the payment to it of such charges as may from time to time be prescribed;.3Schedule 9 has effect to make provision in relation to fees to be charged by the Agency in connection with these Regulations until a charging scheme made under section 41 of the 1995 Act to recover the costs incurred by the Agency in performing functions under these Regulations takes effect.

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/body" NumberOfProvisions="26" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Merchant Shipping Act 1995</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Chapter 3 of Part 6 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Meaning of “the Liability Convention”, “the Bunkers Convention” and other expressions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 152 (meaning of “the Liability Convention” and related expressions) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, before ““the Liability Convention”“ there is inserted ““the Bunkers Convention”,“.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “the Liability Convention”, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Bunkers Convention” means the International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage 2001;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention country” means a country in respect of which the Bunkers Convention is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention State” means a State which is a party to the Bunkers Convention;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Liability Convention State”, after “the” there is inserted “Liability”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), after “Convention” (in the first place it appears), there is inserted “or the Bunkers Convention” and for “the Liability Convention” (in the second place it appears), there is substituted “that Convention”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for oil pollution in case of tankers</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 153 (liability for oil pollution in case of tankers) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter, such a threat is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5" id="regulation-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subsections (7) and (8) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After section 153, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">153A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, any bunker oil is discharged or escapes from a ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken after the discharge or escape for the purpose of preventing or minimising any damage so caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, there arises a grave and imminent threat of damage being caused outside a ship by the contamination that might result if there were a discharge or escape of bunker oil from the ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken for the purpose of preventing or minimising any such damage in the territory of the United Kingdom; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>There shall be no liability under this section in relation to —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship to which section 153 applies, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2) arising in relation to a potential discharge or escape of bunker oil from such a ship,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>where that bunker oil is also persistent hydrocarbon mineral oil.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship, other than a discharge or escape of oil excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a person incurs a liability under subsection (1) or (2) he shall also be liable for any damage or cost for which he would be liable under that subsection if the references in it to the territory of the United Kingdom included the territory of any other Bunkers Convention country.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>as a result of any occurrence, a liability is incurred under this section by the owner of each of two or more ships, but</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the damage or cost for which each of the owners would be liable cannot reasonably be separated from that for which the other or others would be liable,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>each of the owners shall be liable, jointly with the other or others, for the whole of the damage or cost for which the owners together would be liable under this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter (except in section 170(1)) “owner”, except when used in the term “registered owner”, means the registered owner, bareboat charterer, manager and operator of the ship.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Further liability for oil pollution</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1" id="regulation-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 154 (liability for pollution in case of other ships) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2" id="regulation-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, for “in case of other ships” there is substituted “in other cases”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4" id="regulation-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsections (1) and (2), at the beginning there is inserted “Subject to subsection (2A),” and the words “other than a ship to which section 153 applies” are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5" id="regulation-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6" id="regulation-6-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>No liability shall be incurred under this section by reason of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship to which section 153 applies or a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of that section;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within section 153A(1) or a relevant threat of contamination falling within section 153A(2).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship, other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a discharge or escape of oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7" id="regulation-6-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (5), after “section”, there is inserted “(apart from subsection (2A))”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Exceptions from liability under sections 153, 153A and 154</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/1" id="regulation-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 155 (exceptions from liability under sections 153 and 154) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/2" id="regulation-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, after “153”, there is inserted “, 153A”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/3" id="regulation-7-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the words from “No” to “contamination” (in the second place it appears) there is substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>No liability shall be incurred by a person (“the defendant”) under section 153, 153A or 154 by reason of a discharge or escape of oil or bunker oil from a ship, or of a relevant threat of contamination, if the defendant proves that subsection (2) applies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This subsection applies if the discharge or escape or the relevant threat of contamination (as the case may be) —</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/4" id="regulation-7-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph (b), for “owner”, there is substituted “defendant”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Restriction of liability for oil pollution</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8" id="regulation-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/1" id="regulation-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 156 (restriction of liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/2" id="regulation-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, for “oil pollution”, there is substituted “pollution from oil or bunker oil”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3" id="regulation-8-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/a" id="regulation-8-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraphs (a) and (b), there is substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there is a discharge or escape of oil from a ship to which section 153 applies or there arises a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of that section, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there is a discharge or escape of oil falling within section 154(1) or there arises a relevant threat of contamination falling within section 154(2),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/b" id="regulation-8-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for “owner”, there is substituted “registered owner”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/4" id="regulation-8-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), for “owner”, in both places, there is substituted “registered owner”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/5" id="regulation-8-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where, as a result of any occurrence—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there is a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within section 153A(1), or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there arises a relevant threat of contamination falling within section 153A(2),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>then, whether or not the owner of the ship in question incurs any liability under section 153A—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>he shall not be liable otherwise than under that section for any such damage or cost as is mentioned in it; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>no person to whom this paragraph applies shall be liable for any such damage or cost unless it resulted from anything done or omitted to be done by him either with intent to cause any such damage or cost or recklessly and in the knowledge that any such damage or cost would probably result.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subsection (2A)(ii) applies to—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any servant or agent of the owner;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any person not falling within paragraph (a) above but engaged in any capacity on board the ship or to perform any service for the ship;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any person performing salvage operations with the consent of the owner of the ship or on the instructions of a competent public authority;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any person taking any such measures as are mentioned in subsection (1)(b) or (2)(a) of section 153A;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any servant or agent of a person falling within paragraph (c) or (d).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/6" id="regulation-8-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (3), for “the owner of a ship under section 153 or 154”, there is substituted “a person under section 153, 153A or 154”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability under section 153, 153A or 154: supplementary provisions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/9" id="regulation-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After section 156, there is inserted—-</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Liability under section 153, 153A or 154: supplementary provisions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">156A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Chapter —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to a discharge or escape of oil or bunker oil from a ship are references to such a discharge or escape wherever it may occur;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to a discharge or escape of oil from a ship include a discharge or escape of oil carried in the bunkers of the ship;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where more than one discharge or escape of oil or bunker oil results from the same occurrence or from a series of occurrences having the same origin, they shall be treated as one, but any measures taken after the first of them shall be deemed to have been taken after the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where a relevant threat of contamination results from a series of occurrences having the same origin, they shall be treated as a single occurrence.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Law Reform (Contributory Negligence) Act 1945<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> and, in Northern Ireland, the Law Reform (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act (Northern Ireland) 1948<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> shall apply in relation to any damage or cost for which a person is liable under section 153, 153A or 154, but which is not due to his fault, as if it were due to his fault.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Limitation of liability under section 153</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/10" id="regulation-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the cross-heading before section 157, at the end, there is inserted “<Emphasis>under section 153</Emphasis>”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11" id="regulation-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 157 (limitation of liability under section 153) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/a" id="regulation-11-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (1), for “owner” there is substituted “registered owner” and after “contamination” there is inserted “falling within subsection (2) of that section”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/b" id="regulation-11-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (3), for “owner” there is substituted “registered owner”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/body" NumberOfProvisions="26" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Merchant Shipping Act 1995</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Chapter 3 of Part 6 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Meaning of “the Liability Convention”, “the Bunkers Convention” and other expressions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 152 (meaning of “the Liability Convention” and related expressions) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, before ““the Liability Convention”“ there is inserted ““the Bunkers Convention”,“.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “the Liability Convention”, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Bunkers Convention” means the International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage 2001;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention country” means a country in respect of which the Bunkers Convention is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention State” means a State which is a party to the Bunkers Convention;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Liability Convention State”, after “the” there is inserted “Liability”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), after “Convention” (in the first place it appears), there is inserted “or the Bunkers Convention” and for “the Liability Convention” (in the second place it appears), there is substituted “that Convention”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
