<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Chapter 3 of Part 6 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Meaning of “the Liability Convention”, “the Bunkers Convention” and other expressions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 152 (meaning of “the Liability Convention” and related expressions) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, before ““the Liability Convention”“ there is inserted ““the Bunkers Convention”,“.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “the Liability Convention”, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Bunkers Convention” means the International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage 2001;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention country” means a country in respect of which the Bunkers Convention is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention State” means a State which is a party to the Bunkers Convention;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Liability Convention State”, after “the” there is inserted “Liability”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), after “Convention” (in the first place it appears), there is inserted “or the Bunkers Convention” and for “the Liability Convention” (in the second place it appears), there is substituted “that Convention”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for oil pollution in case of tankers</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 153 (liability for oil pollution in case of tankers) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter, such a threat is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5" id="regulation-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subsections (7) and (8) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After section 153, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">153A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, any bunker oil is discharged or escapes from a ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken after the discharge or escape for the purpose of preventing or minimising any damage so caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, there arises a grave and imminent threat of damage being caused outside a ship by the contamination that might result if there were a discharge or escape of bunker oil from the ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken for the purpose of preventing or minimising any such damage in the territory of the United Kingdom; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>There shall be no liability under this section in relation to —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship to which section 153 applies, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2) arising in relation to a potential discharge or escape of bunker oil from such a ship,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>where that bunker oil is also persistent hydrocarbon mineral oil.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship, other than a discharge or escape of oil excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a person incurs a liability under subsection (1) or (2) he shall also be liable for any damage or cost for which he would be liable under that subsection if the references in it to the territory of the United Kingdom included the territory of any other Bunkers Convention country.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>as a result of any occurrence, a liability is incurred under this section by the owner of each of two or more ships, but</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the damage or cost for which each of the owners would be liable cannot reasonably be separated from that for which the other or others would be liable,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>each of the owners shall be liable, jointly with the other or others, for the whole of the damage or cost for which the owners together would be liable under this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter (except in section 170(1)) “owner”, except when used in the term “registered owner”, means the registered owner, bareboat charterer, manager and operator of the ship.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Further liability for oil pollution</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1" id="regulation-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 154 (liability for pollution in case of other ships) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2" id="regulation-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, for “in case of other ships” there is substituted “in other cases”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4" id="regulation-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsections (1) and (2), at the beginning there is inserted “Subject to subsection (2A),” and the words “other than a ship to which section 153 applies” are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5" id="regulation-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6" id="regulation-6-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>No liability shall be incurred under this section by reason of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship to which section 153 applies or a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of that section;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within section 153A(1) or a relevant threat of contamination falling within section 153A(2).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship, other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a discharge or escape of oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7" id="regulation-6-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (5), after “section”, there is inserted “(apart from subsection (2A))”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Text>For point 4 of the General Principles at the start of Annex I (Essential health and safety requirements relating to the design and construction of machinery) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1>

<P1para>
<Text>This Annex is organised in several parts. The first one is of general scope and applicable to all kinds of machinery. The other parts refer to certain kinds of more specific hazards. When machinery is being designed, the requirements of the general part and the requirements of one or more of the other parts shall be taken into account, depending on the results of the risk assessment carried out in accordance with point 1 of these General Principles. xmls: Amendment of the Merchant Shipping and Fishing Vessels (Health and Safety at Work) (Asbestos) Regulations 2010 2 1 The Merchant Shipping and Fishing Vessels (Health and Safety at Work) (Asbestos) Regulations 2010 are amended as follows. 2 In regulation 2 (interpretation), in the definition of asbestos, for “chrysotile, CAS No 12001-29-5” substitute “chrysotile, CAS No 12001-29-5 or CAS No 132207-32-0”. 3 In regulation 4 (application)— a in paragraph (8)(c)(i) after “activities” insert “in which only non-friable materials are handled”, and b in paragraph (8) (c) (ii) after “removal” delete “of” and insert “without deterioration of non-degraded”. 4 After regulation 29 insert— Review 30 1 The Secretary of State must from time to time— a carry out a review of these Regulations, b set out the conclusions of the review in a report; and c publish the report. 2 In carrying out the review the Secretary of State must have regard to how Council Directive 2009/148/EC , on the protection of workers from the risks of exposure to asbestos at work is implemented in other Member States. 3 The report must in particular— a set out the objectives intended to be achieved by the regulatory system established by those regulations; b assess the extent to which those objectives are achieved ; and c assess whether those objectives remain appropriate and, if so, the extent to which they could be achieved with a system that imposes less regulation. 4 The first report under this regulation must be published before the end of the period of five years expiring on 12th July 2018. 5 Reports under this regulation are afterwards to be published at intervals not exceeding five years. .

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2017/1149/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/1149" NumberOfProvisions="42" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2017/1149/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/1149/body" NumberOfProvisions="42"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Merchant Shipping (Working Time: Inland Waterways) Regulations 2003</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2017/1149/regulation/18/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/1149/regulation/18" id="regulation-18">
<Pnumber>18</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Omit regulation 14 (other special cases) and insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P1group>
<Title>Emergency situations</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">14A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>No provision of these regulations shall prevent the master from requiring a worker to perform any hours of work necessary—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for the immediate safety of—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the ship;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>persons on board; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>cargo; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for the purpose of giving assistance to—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>other ships; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>persons in distress.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In the circumstances described in paragraph (1), the master may require a worker to perform any hours of work necessary until the normal situation has been restored.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>As soon as practicable after the normal situation has been restored, the master shall ensure that any worker who has performed work in a scheduled rest period is provided with an adequate period of rest.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110" NumberOfProvisions="36" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/body" NumberOfProvisions="36"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/part/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/part/3" NumberOfProvisions="2" id="part-3"><Number>PART 3</Number><Title>Amendment of other Regulations</Title><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Air Quality Standards (Wales) Regulations 2010</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19" id="regulation-19">
<Pnumber>19</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/1" id="regulation-19-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Air Quality Standards (Wales) Regulations 2010 are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2" id="regulation-19-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 20(8) insert—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/a" id="regulation-19-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the English language text—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The air quality plan must include an assessment of the need to apply lower emission limit values for individual medium combustion plants than those set out in <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2015/2193" id="c00004" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2015" Number="2193">Directive 2015/2193/EU</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council of 25 November 2015 on the limitation of emissions of certain pollutants into the air from medium combustion plants (“the Medium Combustion Plant Directive”) provided that, in the opinion of the Welsh Ministers, applying such emission limit values would effectively contribute to a noticeable improvement of air quality.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In considering whether to impose lower emission limit values, the Welsh Ministers must take into account the results of the information exchange referred to in Article 6(10) of the Medium Combustion Plant Directive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this regulation—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“emission limit values” has the meaning given in paragraph 5 of Schedule 25A to the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“medium combustion plants” has the meaning given in paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 25A to those Regulations.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/b" id="regulation-19-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the Welsh language text insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Rhaid i’r cynllun ansawdd aer gynnwys asesiad o’r angen i gymhwyso gwerthoedd terfyn allyriadau is ar gyfer gweithfeydd hylosgi canolig unigol na’r rhai a nodir yng Nghyfarwyddeb 2015/2193/EU Senedd Ewrop a’r Cyngor ar 25 Tachwedd 2015 ar gyfyngu ar allyriadau llygryddion penodol i’r aer o weithfeydd hylosgi canolig (“y Gyfarwyddeb Gweithfeydd Hylosgi Canolig”) ar yr amod, ym marn Gweinidogion Cymru, y byddai cymhwyso gwerthoedd terfyn allyriadau o’r fath yn cyfrannu’n effeithiol at welliant amlwg yn ansawdd yr aer.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Wrth ystyried a ddylid gosod gwerthoedd terfyn allyriadau is, rhaid i Weinidogion Cymru ystyried canlyniadau’r cyfnewid gwybodaeth y cyfeirir ato yn Erthygl 6(10) o’r Gyfarwyddeb Gweithfeydd Hylosgi Canolig.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Yn y rheoliad hwn—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>mae i “gwerthoedd terfyn allyriadau” yr un ystyr ag a roddir i “emission limit values” ym mharagraff 5 o Atodlen 25A i Reoliadau Trwyddedu Amgylcheddol (Cymru a Lloegr) 2016; ac</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>mae i “gweithfeydd hylosgi canolig” yr un ystyr ag a roddir i “medium combustion plants” ym mharagraff 2(1) o Atodlen 25A i’r Rheoliadau hynny.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

xmls: Amendment of the Merchant<Strong> </Strong>Shipping (Seamen’s Wages and Accounts) (Fishing Vessels) Regulations 1972 5 1 The Merchant Shipping (Seamen’s Wages and Accounts) (Fishing Vessels) Regulations 1972 are amended as follows. 2 In regulation 1(2)— a in the definition of “seaman”, omit the words from “a” to “vessel” and substitute “every person employed, engaged or working in any capacity on board any fishing vessel, but does not include a person solely engaged as a pilot for the vessel”; b after the definition of “the Act” insert— “fisherman’s work agreement” means an agreement required by regulation 8 of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulation 2018, and a reference to a fisherman’s work agreement in relation to a seafarer who works on a ship means the agreement of that description to which that seafarer is a party in relation to that work; . c omit regulation 2; d in regulation 3, for “crew agreement” substitute “fisherman’s work agreement”; e omit regulations 4 and 5; 3 In regulations 6, 7, 8 and 10 for “crew agreement” in each place where it occurs substitute “fisherman’s work agreement”. 4 In the Schedule— a in paragraph 1 of Part 1— i omit paragraph (a); ii in paragraph (c), before the word “his” insert “if relevant”; b omit Part 3.

<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2(2) (interpretation)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/a" id="regulation-7-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “employer” insert—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“fishing vessel owner” means the owner of the fishing vessel or any other organisation or person such as the manager, agent or bareboat charterer, who has assumed the responsibility for the operation of the vessel from the owner and who, on assuming such responsibility, has agreed to take over the duties and responsibilities imposed on fishing vessel owners in accordance with the Work in Fishing Convention, regardless of whether any other organisation or person fulfils certain of the duties or responsibilities on behalf of the fishing vessel owner;”;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/b" id="regulation-7-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “seafarer” omit the words “which is not a fishing vessel”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/c" id="regulation-7-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “shipowner”, after the word “ship” where it first occurs in sub-paragraph (b) insert “other than a fishing vessel”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/d" id="regulation-7-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>after the definition of “worker” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Work in Fishing Convention” means the convention adopted at Geneva on 14th June 2007 by the International Labour Organisation<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3" id="regulation-7-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3 (application)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/a" id="regulation-7-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (1A) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1B</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>As regards Group D and Group E ships—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the following provisions insofar as they apply to workers, also apply to seafarers who are not workers and insofar as they apply to employers, also apply to fishing vessel owners—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 4(1)(a),</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 5(1),</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 7,</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 12(1) and 12(2), and</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 20.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in relation to seafarers who are not workers, any obligations imposed by the provisions mentioned in paragraph (a), to the extent that they would, by virtue of that paragraph, apply to employers and fishing vessel owners, apply to fishing vessel owners only.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/b" id="regulation-7-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2)(a) omit the words “with the exception of regulations 7(4A), 11A and 12A”,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/c" id="regulation-7-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2A) omit sub-paragraph (a),</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/d" id="regulation-7-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)(b) omit “only” and at the end insert “and Group D ships”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218" NumberOfProvisions="12" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/body" NumberOfProvisions="12"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Cremation (England and Wales) Regulations 2008</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Cremation (England and Wales) Regulations 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> are amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 2 (interpretation)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1), for the definition commencing “medical certificate” and including “confirmatory medical certificate” substitute with—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>“<Term>medical certificate</Term>” is a reference to the certificate so named given in accordance with regulation 17(1);</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 12 (supplementary powers of medical referee)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 12, omit sub-paragraph (a).</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 14 (forms)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 14(2)(b)(i), omit “the confirmatory medical certificate,”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 16</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 16(1)(c)(i) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/6/a" id="regulation-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for “and, subject to regulation 17(3), a confirmatory medical certificate are” substitute <InlineAmendment>“is”</InlineAmendment>, and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/6/b" id="regulation-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit “and (2) respectively”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 17 (medical certificate and confirmatory medical certificate)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 17—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/7/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/7/a" id="regulation-7-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the heading omit “and confirmatory medical certificate”, and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/7/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/7/b" id="regulation-7-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit paragraphs (2), (3) and (4).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 22 (right to inspect medical certificate and confirmatory medical certificate)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8" id="regulation-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 22—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/a" id="regulation-8-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the heading omit “and confirmatory medical certificate”,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/b" id="regulation-8-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 1(a)(i) omit “and confirmatory medical certificate”,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/c" id="regulation-8-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 1(a)(ii) for “those certificates” substitute <InlineAmendment>“that certificate”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/d" id="regulation-8-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) omit “and confirmatory medical certificate” and for “those certificates” substitute <InlineAmendment>“that certificate”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/e" id="regulation-8-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)(a) omit “and confirmatory medical certificate”, and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/218/regulation/8/f" id="regulation-8-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)(b) for “such a” substitute <InlineAmendment>“the”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651" NumberOfProvisions="9" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/body" NumberOfProvisions="9"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> are amended in accordance with regulations 3 to 7.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 2</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2, in paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “mobile plant”, in the words before sub-paragraph (a), after “mobile plant” insert <InlineAmendment>“, in relation to Wales,”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “pollutant”, after “pollutant” insert <InlineAmendment>“, in relation to Wales,”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “<Term id="term-pollution">pollution</Term>”, in relation to a water discharge activity or groundwater activity, after “pollution” insert <InlineAmendment>“, in relation to Wales,”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the appropriate places insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>groundwater mobile plant</Term>” means plant that is—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>designed to move or be moved whether on roads or other land,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>used to carry on a groundwater activity, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>not an installation or Part B mobile plant;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>groundwater Source Protection Zone 1</Term>” means a zone—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>within 50m of a point at which water is abstracted for domestic or food production purposes from any underground strata, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>defined by a 50-day travel time for groundwater to reach a groundwater abstraction point that is used to supply water for domestic or food production purposes,</Text>
<Text>whichever is larger;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>mobile plant</Term>”, in relation to England, means any of the following—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Part B mobile plant;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>waste mobile plant;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>mobile medium combustion plant;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>groundwater mobile plant;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>pollutant</Term>”, in relation to England, means any—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>substance,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>heat, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>biological entity or micro-organism,</Text>
<Text>which is liable to cause pollution;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>pollution</Term>”, in relation to England, in relation to a water discharge activity or groundwater activity, means the direct or indirect introduction, as a result of human activity, of substances, heat or biological entities or micro-organisms into air, water or land which may—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>be harmful to human health or the quality of aquatic ecosystems or terrestrial ecosystems directly depending on aquatic ecosystems,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>result in damage to material property, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>impair or interfere with amenities or other legitimate uses of the environment;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 24</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 24, in paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/4/a" id="regulation-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (d) before the words “a stand-alone water” insert <InlineAmendment>“in relation to Wales,”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/4/b" id="regulation-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to England, a stand-alone water discharge activity or stand-alone groundwater activity other than a discharge to a well or borehole—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which is used for hydrocarbon exploration or extraction, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which intersects a hydrocarbon formation.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of Schedule 3</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In Schedule 3—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/a" id="regulation-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part 2, in paragraph 3, in sub-paragraph (2)(a) for the words from “document entitled” to “updated on 21st January 2015” substitute <InlineAmendment>“document entitled “General binding rules for small sewage discharges (SSDs) with effect from 2nd October 2023” published by the Agency on 23rd March 2023”</InlineAmendment><FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b" id="regulation-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part 3—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/i" id="regulation-5-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph 1, at the appropriate places insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>ancient woodland</Term>” means any area that has been wooded continuously since at least 1600 AD, including ancient semi-natural woodland and plantations on ancient woodland sites;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>protected site</Term>” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>a wetland designated as a European site (which has the meaning given in regulation 8 of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>),</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>a Ramsar site (which has the same meaning as in section 37A of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>),</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>a nature reserve established by a local authority under section 21 of the National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act 1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>a site of special scientific interest (which has the meaning given in section 52(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/ii" id="regulation-5-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph 4, in sub-paragraph (2)—</Text>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/ii/aa/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/ii/aa" id="regulation-5-b-ii-aa">
<Pnumber>aa</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>in paragraph (a) for the words from “document entitled” to “updated on 21st January 2015” substitute <InlineAmendment>“document entitled “General binding rules for small sewage discharges (SSDs) with effect from 2nd October 2023” published by the Agency on 23rd March 2023”</InlineAmendment><FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>;</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/ii/bb/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/ii/bb" id="regulation-5-b-ii-bb">
<Pnumber>bb</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>for paragraph (d) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the discharge does not result in an input of pollutants to groundwater within a groundwater Source Protection Zone 1;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P5para>
</P5>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/iii" id="regulation-5-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph 5, in sub-paragraph (2)—</Text>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/iii/aa/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/iii/aa" id="regulation-5-b-iii-aa">
<Pnumber>aa</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>in paragraph (e), in the words before sub-paragraph (i), before the words “that water” insert <InlineAmendment>“in relation to Wales,”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/iii/bb/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/iii/bb" id="regulation-5-b-iii-bb">
<Pnumber>bb</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>after paragraph (e) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P3>
<Pnumber>ea</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to England, that water from the system must not be discharged within a groundwater Source Protection Zone 1;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P5para>
</P5>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/iv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/5/b/iv" id="regulation-5-b-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>
<Title>Closed-loop ground source heating and cooling systems: England</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purpose of paragraph 8(a)(i) of Schedule 2, the description is a closed-loop ground source heating or cooling system—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>which is fully sealed and does not take water from, or discharge water or fluids into, the environment, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where any borehole is used, the borehole is fully sealed and does not take water from the environment.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purpose of paragraph 8(a)(ii) of Schedule 2, the conditions in relation to a groundwater activity of that description are that an operator of the system ensures that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the system is a closed-loop system only and that there is no discharge of pollutants other than the transfer of heat to the environment,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the system does not cause pollution of surface water or groundwater,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>no part of the system is within a groundwater Source Protection Zone 1,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>no part of the system is within 50m of a well, spring or borehole used to supply water for domestic or food production purposes,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>no part of the system is within the following distance of a protected site or an ancient woodland—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>20m, where the system supplies only residential premises and the maximum output of the system is 45kW or less,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>50m, where the system supplies—</Text>
<P5>
<Pnumber>aa</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>only a single community building,</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5>
<Pnumber>bb</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>only residential premises and the maximum output of the system is more than 45kW,</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5>
<Pnumber>cc</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>only a single building that is not a community building or residential premises and which has a floor space of less than 1000m<Superior>2</Superior>, or</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5>
<Pnumber>dd</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>subject to sub-paragraph (i), more than one building where the total floor space within those buildings combined is less than 1000m<Superior>2</Superior>, or</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>250m in any other case,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the installation of the system does not mobilise any contaminants present in the subsurface to the extent that the pollution of groundwater occurs,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>no part of the system is adjacent to a septic tank or cesspit, including the infiltration system,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>all equipment installed in relation to the system complies with the relevant design and manufacturing standards set down in—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the relevant British Standards, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the relevant Ground Source Heat Pump Association standards, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the system is appropriately decommissioned when it ceases to be in operation so that there is no risk of pollutants or polluting matter entering groundwater.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this regulation—</Text>
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>community building</Term>” includes a building used as a place of worship;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>relevant British Standards</Term>” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>BS EN 378-1:2016+A1:2020 entitled “Refrigerating systems and heat pumps — Safety and environmental requirements, Part 1: Basic requirements, definitions, classification and selection criteria” published by the British Standards Institution on 30th November 2020,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>BS EN 378-2:2016 entitled “Refrigerating systems and heat pumps — Safety and environmental requirements, Part 2: Design, construction, testing, marking and documentation” published by the British Standards Institution on 31st December 2016,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>BS EN 378-3:2016+A1:2020 entitled “Refrigerating systems and heat pumps — Safety and environmental requirements, Part 3: Installation site and personal protection” published by the British Standards Institution on 30th November 2020,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>BS EN 378-4:2016+A1:2019 entitled “Refrigerating systems and heat pumps — Safety and environmental requirements, Part 4: Operation, maintenance, repair and recovery” published by the British Standards Institution on 31st October 2019,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>BS EN 805:2000 entitled “Water supply — Requirements for systems and components outside buildings” published by the British Standards Institution and coming into effect on 15th September 2000, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>BS 5930:2015+A1:2020 entitled “Code of practice for ground investigations” published by the British Standards Institution on 31st May 2020;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant Ground Source Heat Pump Association standards”<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> means—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the Closed-loop Vertical Borehole Design, Installation and Materials Standards, issue 1.0, dated 2020 and published by the Ground Source Heat Pump Association,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the Shallow Ground Source Standard, Version 2, dated January 2018 and published by the Ground Source Heat Pump Association, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the Thermal Pile Design, Installation and Materials Standards, Version 2, dated September 2018 and published by the Ground Source Heat Pump Association.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Low-environmental-risk burials at new cemeteries or new extensions of cemeteries: England</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purpose of paragraph 8(a)(i) of Schedule 2, the description is any burial of human remains, other than a burial of human ashes from crematoria, within a new cemetery or new extension of a cemetery.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In sub-paragraph (1), “<Term>new cemetery or new extension of a cemetery</Term>” means a development which, by virtue of section 57 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>, required planning permission authorising a change of use of land to permit burials which was granted on or after 2nd October 2023.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purpose of paragraph 8(a)(ii) of Schedule 2, the conditions in relation to a burial of that description are that the operator ensures that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any activity relating to the burial must not cause pollution of surface water or groundwater,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the burial is not within 10m of any field drain, including any dry ditch,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the grave has at least 1m clearance between the base of the grave and the top of the water table,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the burial is not undertaken directly into groundwater,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the grave is not dug in unaltered or unweathered bedrock,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the grave is not dug in an area susceptible to groundwater flooding,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the burial is not within 30m of any spring or watercourse,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the burial is not in, or within 50m of, a protected site,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the burial is not in an ancient woodland,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the new cemetery or extension in question does not have more than 2500 burials per hectare, in proportion to the total area of the new cemetery or extension,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>no part of the new cemetery or extension in question is within a groundwater Source Protection Zone 1,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>no part of the new cemetery or extension in question is within 250m of any well, spring or borehole that is used to supply water for domestic drinking or food production purposes,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the new cemetery or extension is located either—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>entirely on strata which are unproductive strata,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>entirely on strata which are a secondary B aquifer or entirely on strata which are secondary undifferentiated rocks, where the number of burials is less than 100 burials per annum,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>entirely on a secondary A aquifer, where the number of burials is less than 50 burials per annum,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>entirely on a principal aquifer and not in a groundwater Source Protection Zone 2, where the number of burials is less than 30 burials per annum, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>on any combination of strata mentioned in paragraphs (i) to (iv), subject to sub-paragraph (4), and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the new cemetery or extension does not need ongoing active control measures to be in place to protect the environment.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a new cemetery or extension is, pursuant to sub-paragraph (3)(m)(v), partly located on one of the strata mentioned in sub-paragraph (3)(m)(ii), (iii) or (iv), the restriction on the numbers of burials per annum in sub-paragraph (3)(m)(ii), (iii) or (iv) (as the case may be) applies to the area of the new cemetery or extension located on that strata.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In sub-paragraph (3)—</Text>
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>groundwater flooding</Term>” means flooding where the water table beneath the ground rises and causes water to seep out at ground level;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>groundwater Source Protection Zone 2</Term>” means a zone—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>within—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="roman" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>250m of a point at which water is abstracted for domestic or food production purposes from underground strata where the maximum allowable annual volume as authorised by a licence under section 24 of the Water Resources Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/> or allowed by virtue of section 27 of that Act (as the case may be) divided by 365 is less than 2,000 m3 per day, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>500m of a point at which water is abstracted for domestic or food production purposes from underground strata where the maximum allowable annual volume as authorised by a licence under section 24 of the Water Resources Act 1991 divided by 365 is equal to or greater than 2,000 m3 per day, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>defined by a 400-day travel time for groundwater to reach a groundwater abstraction point that is used to supply water for domestic or food production purposes,</Text>
<Text>whichever is larger;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>principal aquifer</Term>” means geological strata which—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>exhibit a high intergranular or fracture permeability, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>provide a high level of water storage and support water supply or base flow to rivers, lakes and wetlands on a strategic scale;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>secondary A aquifer</Term>” means permeable strata capable of supporting water supplies at a local rather than strategic scale;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>secondary B aquifer</Term>” means predominantly lower permeability strata including where they have, in part, the ability to store and yield limited amounts of groundwater by virtue of localised features such as fissures, thin permeable horizons or weathering;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>secondary undifferentiated rocks</Term>” means rock deposits or strata with variable permeability and storage properties which are not consistently a secondary A aquifer or secondary B aquifer;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>unproductive strata</Term>” means geological strata which—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>have a low permeability that has negligible significance for water supply or river base flow, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>consist of deposits that naturally offer protection to any aquifers that may be present beneath.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of Schedule 21</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In Schedule 21, in paragraph 6—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/6/a" id="regulation-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (5), for the words “A sewerage undertaker” substitute <InlineAmendment>“In relation to Wales, a sewerage undertaker”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/6/b" id="regulation-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (5) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to England, a sewerage undertaker is not guilty of an offence under regulation 38(1) or (2) in relation to a water discharge activity that consists of a discharge of sewage effluent from a sewer or works vested in it if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the contravention is attributable to a discharge which another person caused or knowingly permitted to be made into the sewer or works,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the undertaker either was not bound to receive the discharge into the sewer or works or was bound to receive it there subject to conditions which were not observed, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the undertaker could not reasonably have been expected to prevent the discharge into the sewer or works.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of Schedule 22</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In Schedule 22—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/a" id="regulation-7-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 7—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/a/i" id="regulation-7-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (4) after “granted” insert <InlineAmendment>“in relation to Wales”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/a/ii" id="regulation-7-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (4) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A permit may not be granted in relation to England—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>without an assessment of—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the relevant hydrogeological conditions,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the possible purifying powers of soil and subsoil, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the risk of pollution and alteration of the quality of the groundwater from the discharge, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>without establishing whether the input of pollutants to groundwater is a satisfactory solution from the point of view of the environment.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/b" id="regulation-7-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 8—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/b/i" id="regulation-7-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>renumber the existing text as sub-paragraph (1) of that paragraph;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/b/ii" id="regulation-7-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (1) (as renumbered), at the end insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P3>
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to England, any groundwater activity to remediate the effects of pollution in groundwater or in the land or waters surrounding groundwater;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to England, the injection of any substance into groundwater to increase the flow of fluids or gas to a well or borehole in connection with the extraction or use of any source of energy.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/b/iii" id="regulation-7-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (1) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In sub-paragraph (1)(k), the reference to remediating the effects of pollution is—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of the groundwater in question, to doing any works, carrying out any operations or taking any steps to prevent or minimise, or remedy or mitigate the effects of pollution, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of land or waters surrounding the groundwater in question, to restoring the land or waters to (or closer to) their former state.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/c" id="regulation-7-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 13—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/c/i" id="regulation-7-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (5), for the words “A sewerage undertaker” substitute <InlineAmendment>“In relation to Wales, a sewerage undertaker”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/651/regulation/7/c/ii" id="regulation-7-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (5) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to England, a sewerage undertaker is not guilty of an offence under regulation 38(1) or (2) in relation to a groundwater activity that consists of a discharge of sewage effluent from a sewer or works vested in it if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the contravention is attributable to a discharge which another person caused or knowingly permitted to be made into the sewer or works,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the undertaker either was not bound to receive the discharge into the sewer or works or was bound to receive it there subject to conditions which were not observed, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the undertaker could not reasonably have been expected to prevent the discharge into the sewer or works.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Environmental Damage (Prevention and Remediation) (Wales) Regulations 2009 are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1) (interpretation), in the appropriate place in alphabetical order insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“baseline” (“<Emphasis>gwaelodlin</Emphasis>”) means the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured for the purposes of the Territorial Sea Act 1987<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“marine waters” (“dyfroedd morol”) means waters classified as marine waters pursuant to Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2008/0056" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2008" Number="56">2008/56/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing a framework for Community action in the field of marine environmental policy<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 4 (meaning of “environmental damage”)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/a" id="regulation-2-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/a/i" id="regulation-2-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (b) omit the second “or”;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/a/ii" id="regulation-2-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>omit sub-paragraph (c) and insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>marine waters, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>land,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/b" id="regulation-2-3-b">

<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
